title: Head of Planning
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

  • Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.

  • High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.

  • Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.

  • Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.

  • Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

THE ROLE

Head of Planning

We’re looking for a Head of Planning to join our growing Operations team. You will play a critical role in optimizing Quince’s inventory performance by leading all Inventory Planning and Forecasting functions for a specific area of the business portfolio, TBD. In this role, you will own forecasting and replenishment for your business, driving optimal inventory turns, improve in-stock performance, and maximize return on investment. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence.

Because Quince’s business model is unique, this position will be equally unique in its execution—combining analytical rigor, strategic partnership, and active collaboration with merchandising, sourcing, technology, and vendor teams. This is a hands-on role that requires a high level of performance and execution, aligned with Quince’s operating principles.

Success in this position means working within and building best-in-class forecasting systems that balance product availability with working capital efficiency while supporting Quince’s mission to deliver luxury quality at radically low prices. As a part of the Planning team, this person will play a critical role in shaping future Planning processes at Quince, helping to architect the solutions and capabilities of tomorrow to support our rapid growth.

This role will report directly to a VP of Inventory Planning.

Responsibilities

  • Forecast items at the style-color-size level by week, achieving key performance indicators including in-stock rates, inventory turns, and return on investment.
  • Partner closely with the internal sourcing team and external vendors to collaborate on forecasts and maximize product availability.
  • Work directly with the technology team to develop and implement integrated, intelligent, and automated forecasting solutions.
  • Conduct analytics and root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for KPI improvement.
  • Collaborate with sourcing to model vendor relationships, terms, and risk profiles.
  • Build short-, mid-, and long-range inventory and replenishment plans that align with business strategy.
  • Present forecasts, strategies, and performance updates weekly to executives.
  • Manage and mentor one or more team members as the function scales.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Looking for candidates at the Sr. Manager level or above - Director-level preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in inventory planning, merchandising, or related analytics/technology roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or Master’s in Supply Chain Management preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in advanced Excel statistical functions.
  • Fluency with Google Suite and comfort working with large data sets.
  • Experience prototyping inventory optimization techniques and converting insights into scalable technology.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners to maximize opportunities and minimize risks.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to find, organize, and use data to draw actionable conclusions with minimal assumptions.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment where established processes may not yet exist.

Preferred:

    • Insatiable curiosity and a desire to uncover insights that drive results.
    • Willingness to form and share informed points of view with peers and executives.
    • Ability to pivot quickly and thrive in a dynamic, startup-like environment.
    • Commitment to building scalable processes and industry-leading technology.
    • Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
    • Strong understanding of how forecasting impacts company priorities, objectives, and financial performance.
    • Bias toward leveraging technology for operational improvement.

Pay Range: $189,000 - $247,000

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$189,000—$247,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Writing - Capital One Software
description:
Senior Manager, Technical Writing - Capital One Software (Remote)

Ever since our first credit card customer in 1994, Capital One has recognized that technology and data can enable even large companies to be innovative and personalized. As one of the first large enterprises to go all-in on the public cloud, Capital One needed to build cloud and data management tools that didn’t exist in the marketplace to enable us to operate at scale in the cloud. And in 2022, we publicly announced Capital One Software and brought our first B2B software solution, Slingshot, to market.

Building on Capital One’s pioneering adoption of modern cloud and data capabilities, Capital One Software is helping accelerate and secure the data management journey at scale for businesses operating in the cloud. If you think of the kind of challenges that companies face – things like data publishing, data consumption, data governance, data security and infrastructure management – we’ve built tools to address these various needs along the way. Capital One Software will continue to explore where we can bring our solutions to market to help other businesses address these same needs going forward.

​This experienced Senior Manager of Technical Writing will sit at the intersection of leadership and execution. In this "player-coach" capacity, you will be responsible for defining our documentation strategy and mentoring a team of writers. Additionally you will drive development oftechnical documentation that translates complex information into user-friendly content that enables successful onboarding and utilization of Slingshot & Databolt by customers, partners and internal stakeholders. This candidate will be responsible for managing a team of technical documentation specialists and should have in-depth experience creating various forms of customer-facing documentation, including user manuals, help files, system integration guides, SDKs, API documentation, and FAQS . The candidate should be able to communicate complex information clearly and efficiently to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of technical writers. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, provide actionable feedback, and support career development.

  • Define the documentation vision, including tool selection, style guides, and information architecture.

  • Act as the primary bridge between Engineering, Product Management, and Support to ensure documentation is integrated into the Software Development Life Cycle.

  • Prioritize projects and manage the team’s bandwidth to meet tight release deadlines without sacrificing quality.

  • Create and implement documentation strategy within a cross-functional organization that supports documentation usability and innovation

  • Review documentation for consistency across processes through application of standards and style guides

  • Maintain and improve our Docs-as-Code workflow (Git, Markdown, CI/CD pipelines).

  • Transform complex, technical material into clear and concise documentation that will be read by target audience members such as Engineers, Product Managers, Architects, and Senior Leadership.

  • Create technical documentation for APIs, SDKs and integrations

  • Translate complex ideas into understandable logical concepts using both architectural diagrams and supporting descriptions

  • Write in a formal technical writing style (for example, active voice, implied you, consistent tenses, etc.)

  • Conduct in-depth interviews with subject matter experts to fully understand the architecture or products

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers and architects on a daily basis to develop, publish and maintain high quality customer-focused documentation

  • Rely upon metrics and other forms of data to understand the variation in utility of the content, identify areas in need of review, and to drive planning & prioritization

  • Develop Content that drives searchability for SEO and LLM optimization

  • Maintain and continuously update content management system(s) of documentation

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience.

  • At least 10 years of experience writing technical documentation for software solutions

  • At least 4 years of people management experience

  • At least 3 years of experience with Markdown and Git

​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience working with documentation authoring tools, e.g., Hugo, GitBook, and Confluence.

  • Experience writing technical documentation for data security software

  • Skilled at transforming deeply technical content into clear, useful customer-focused materials

  • Ability to collaborate with developers to translate their content into easily understood documentation

  • Experience writing in an Agile software development process

  • Strong understanding of data management technologies and processes

  • 3+ years of experience with SDLC

  • 3+ years of experience in software development

  • 1+ year experience in a financial services industry

  • 3+ years experience working in an Agile environment

title: Solutions Architect I
description:
Job ID: 27-0351

Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud-enabled, enterprise-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 200,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them — in ways they may not even know they are at risk — so they can focus on taking their business to the next level.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.

Envision yourself at Barracuda

The Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect is responsible for providing presales support to Barracuda’s customers. This role facilitates workshops, validates technical requirements, answers advanced technical questions, delivers product demonstrations, manages POV/POC process, and collaborates with sales teams on sales opportunities. It also follows up with prospective customers during the evaluation phase to ensure they have the necessary support and information.

Responsibilities:

  • Works on gathering client requirements, performing fit-gap analysis and shaping high level client solutions based on Barracuda’s products

  • Manages technical engagements, such as briefings, proof of concepts and architectural design sessions

  • Contributes to the delivery of workshops, bootcamps, and trainings necessary to build partners’ technical skills

  • Delivers compelling product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the features and benefits of network security solutions

  • Works on projects involving the task of qualifying opportunities, validating technical requirements, and providing appropriate product recommendations to ensure customer needs are met

  • Answers technical questions, overcomes objections, and helps sales position against competitive solutions to secure customer buy-in

  • Responds to RFI’s and RFP’s and engages with appropriate internal resources like sales, product management, product marketing, CSE’s, and others when necessary to help close opportunities

  • Conducts security assessments and audits of client networks to identify vulnerabilities and recommend solutions for remediation.

  • Follows up with prospective customers during the evaluation phase to ensure they have the necessary support and information

  • Collaborates with sales teams to ensure the smooth transition of projects from pre-sales to post-sales phase and offer guidance on network security design and configuration based on client requirements

  • Leverages specialized sales engineering knowledge in breadth and/or depth to a variety of issues/projects within the team

  • Works in a project-oriented manner contributing towards team-level goals

  • Works closely with channel solutions teams to identify customer needs and provide tailored solutions

  • Assists channel solutions team in analyzing sales data and/or developing strategies for sales' process improvement

  • Works with Key Channel Partners and Distributors to help them build Competence

Technical Know How:

  • Network & Infrastructure Security: hands-on experience with WAN/LAN, VLANs, VPNs, routing, firewalls, QoS, and SNMP

  • Vast experience in cloud security

  • Proven success in sales engineering or consulting

  • Familiarity with security threat vectors

  • CompTIA Security+ or similar certification is a plus

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Sales Engineering or a similar technical pre-sales role

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, including users, remote users, networks, and applications

  • Knowledge of the network security market and current threat landscape

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with strong attention to detail

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage changing priorities

  • Proven ability to support the sales cycle and help close business while ensuring high customer satisfaction

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

What you’ll get from us:

A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda.

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
description:
About The Position

This role is responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing data engineering pipelines, managing data platform operations, and partnering closely with stakeholders to drive requirements-gathering and defining data solution architecture. This is a hands-on role that creates, drives, and tracks project plans for data platform and solutions delivery (including, but not limited to, ETL/Extract-Transform-Load, pipelines, data models, and monitoring controls) and leads sprint planning and completion to meet business needs while implementing and continuously improving solutions. The Senior Manager, Data Engineering reports to the Senior Director of Data Management & Governance.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of data architecture and pipeline solutions, including holistic planning, requirements-gathering, design, build, and testing strategy per assessed business needs. Design and evolve the semantic layer to be the well-governed single source of truth for business intelligence and ensure it is meeting all reporting needs.

  • Lead sprint planning and operations. Manage sprint execution, release planning and release delivery, ensuring aligned planning, timely outcomes, and resolution of dependencies and blockers to drive operational excellence. Track and analyze sprint delivery metrics, sprint operational efficiency, and DevOps performance (e.g., DevOps Research and Assessment framework) to support continuous improvement.

  • Design and operationalize data quality framework to ensure trust and consistency in data, with proactive monitoring, alerting, root cause analysis (including troubleshooting and resolution) with impact and sizing assessments for all critical data pipelines.

  • Establish foundational capabilities for MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), Machine Learning, and feature engineering along with ML/AI platform integration as organizational needs mature.

  • Manage and continuously improve data architecture and pipelines, establishing clear monitoring standards and operational controls.

  • Partner closely with stakeholders on the Analytics, Application Development, Data Collection Strategy & Operations, IT Operations, Product Management, and Regional Data Systems & Strategy teams to lead communication and own, create, drive, track, and execute project plans for owned workstreams, effectively managing competing priorities to ensure data availability and accuracy for users.

  • Ensure transparency into progress, risks, and dependencies through consistent tracking and communication mechanisms.

  • Guide team member(s) on developing data solutions, promoting strong data quality practices and review standards, and ensuring up-to-date documentation.

  • Manage and develop one or more team members (FTEs or contractors) as needed, providing clear expectations, timely feedback, and coaching to support performance and accountability for results.

Skills and Mindsets

  • Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s Core Values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action)

  • Self-Management: Demonstrated record of co-creating ambitious goals with their managers – and driving toward desired outcomes; Effectively monitors progress toward goals for multiple workstreams; Leverages understanding of an organization’s operating model, structure, and core operational process to effectively drive work to achieve goals; effectively works through direct reports and peers to follow through on commitments, ensuring others do the same.

  • Work Management: Effectively drives work they own through clear action planning. Manages time effectively around competing priorities. Skilled in creating and executing project plans through partnership with stakeholders and effective delegation to achieve intended results on time. Skilled in knowledge management.

  • Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; leverages relevant organizational processes and systems to execute work; can build and maintain knowledge management systems; effectively develops and codifies processes to ensure efficiency, alignment with organizational processes, and to improve work quality.

  • Problem-Solving: Generates solutions outside of their direct work and shrinks problems to solve independently. Shows initiative in generating and recommending ideas and solutions within their own workstreams. Anticipates risks and develops proactive solutions that support their team.

  • People Management & Development: Effective at developing and coaching teammates. Skilled in setting and managing both performance and development goals. Provides timely and actionable feedback to drive teammate development and performance; demonstrates accountability for the goals of their direct reports

  • Technical Proficiency: Has knowledge and skills in SQL, Spark, Pyspark, on-prem and cloud-based data platform management (SQL Server, Fabric/Snowflake, etc.) and architecture, CI/CD, ETL/data pipelines, version control, SSIS, agile sprint operations, project management tools, and machine learning principles.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Experience with SQL-based data platforms (such as SQL Server) and modern cloud-based data warehouse/lakehouse platforms, such as Fabric/OneLake, Snowflake, or Databricks.

  • Demonstrated experience in managing agile sprint operations, DevOps metrics, and proficiency in JIRA (or similar tool) for project and sprint planning, sprint and backlog management, sprint tracking, workflow management, and issue resolution.

  • Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows using Git and platforms, such as Bitbucket, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.

  • Strong technical proficiency in SSIS, Spark, PySpark, and SQL.

  • Demonstrated experience managing data platform operations and building/managing ETLs and pipelines.

  • Experience managing and mentoring data engineers.

  • Understanding of Machine Learning (ML) workflows and ML/AI enablement for data platforms.

  • Experience with SQL Server and MS Fabric/OneLake preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in data engineering, computer science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

Work Conditions

Location

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role also has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Compensation and Benefits

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $123,500. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including:

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services, you will be tasked with taking ownership of our AI Gateway infrastructure (built on Kong AI Gateway), the system that authenticates, routes, rate-limits, and monitors AI coding assistant traffic org-wide, while also being fluent enough across our broader platform stack to design solutions that span the two. This is a high-autonomy, high-scope role: you will set technical direction for AI infrastructure, drive incident response and reliability work, and partner closely with the engineers who own our CI/CD, GitOps, and artifact systems rather than working in isolation from them.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Work on the AI Gateway platform: architect, harden, and scale our Kong AI Gateway deployment (Konnect Hybrid on KCP/EKS), including auth (Okta/OIDC), consumer tiers and budgets, rate limiting, semantic caching, and observability.
  • Lead reliability and incident response: drive root-cause analysis and remediation for gateway issues (timeouts, latency, capacity, failover) and build the monitoring/alerting needed to catch them before users do.
  • Design across the platform, not just the gateway: work fluently with our CI/CD (Jenkins, JPAAS), GitOps and Kubernetes deployment tooling (ArgoCD across dev/gov/prod), artifact management (Artifactory/Xray), GitHub Enterprise administration, and GitHub Actions runner fleet, so that AI infrastructure decisions account for how the rest of the platform actually works.
  • Evaluate and roll out AI developer tooling: run structured pilots and adoption efforts for tools like AI-assisted PR review (Qodo) and engineering metrics platforms (LinearB), and make clear build-vs-buy recommendations.
  • Set technical direction and mentor: define architecture and standards for AI infrastructure, review designs across the team, and raise the bar for other engineers working in this space.
  • Partner cross-functionally: work directly with security, DevEx, and product engineering teams consuming the gateway to translate their needs into platform capabilities.
  • Host and serve local models: stand up and operate self-hosted/open-weight model serving infrastructure (e.g. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama) for workloads where routing to an external provider isn't the right fit, including GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, and cost/performance tuning.
  • Support the broader model lifecycle: help build LLMOps practices such as model versioning, evaluation, and safe rollout, plus supporting infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores, embedding pipelines) as use cases mature.
  • Track usage and cost: build observability into token usage, latency, and spend across both API-based and self-hosted models so the business can see what AI infrastructure actually costs.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with a track record of owning systems end-to-end in production.
  • Hands-on experience with API gateway technologies (Kong, Envoy, Apigee, or similar); direct experience with AI/LLM gateway patterns (rate limiting, semantic caching, prompt/response observability) is a strong plus.
  • Strong Kubernetes and GitOps experience (ArgoCD or comparable), and comfort operating across multiple environments (dev, gov, prod).
  • Solid CI/CD background: Jenkins pipeline design and administration, build infrastructure, and runner/agent fleet management (GitHub Actions runners or equivalent).
  • Experience with artifact and package management systems (Artifactory, Xray, or similar) and source control platform administration (GitHub Enterprise).
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS/EKS).
  • Experience deploying and operating self-hosted LLM inference stacks (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama, or similar) and GPU-backed infrastructure, including Kubernetes GPU scheduling and autoscaling.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps practices: model versioning, evaluation harnesses, and usage/cost observability across API-based and self-hosted models.
  • Track record of setting technical direction, driving cross-team initiatives, and mentoring other engineers; this role has significant scope and minimal day-to-day oversight.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who can explain infrastructure trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience operating LLM/AI-assisted developer tooling at scale (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) inside an enterprise is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Okta/OIDC and enterprise auth patterns for internal platforms is preferred.
  • Experience with engineering productivity metrics tooling (LinearB or similar) and AI-based code review tooling (Qodo or similar) is preferred.
  • Experience with vector databases and RAG pipelines (e.g. Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar) in a production setting is preferred.
  • Exposure to model fine-tuning or lightweight training pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA or similar) for domain-specific model adaptation is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

title: Communications Engineer
description:
Astroscale is seeking to employ an experienced and motivated Satellite Communications Engineer at our facility based in Harwell, UK.

This is an exciting position, with responsibilities covering the full lifecycle of our spacecraft; from early design of the electronic systems and interfaces to hands-on work through to creating test plans and being part of the AIV activities. As the team is still quite small, if offers the incumbent the potential to be instrumental in the Communications engineering direction.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and rapidly growing company seeking to make a positive contribution to the growing problem of orbital debris that endangers mankind’s continued use of space as an asset. The technology of our mission is complex and demanding, with a high amount of data going through the system. As the mission requires our spacecraft to move towards another spacecraft, it has many unique and critical features within the communication system.

Responsibilities

  • Support the design, development and delivery of satellite communications subsystems across the full spacecraft lifecycle, from early concept and requirements definition through to integration, verification and mission operations.
  • Review, develop and maintain communications subsystem requirements, specifications and interface definitions, including supplier-facing requirements where appropriate.
  • Define and develop communications subsystem verification strategies, test plans and acceptance criteria for spacecraft equipment and system-level validation.
  • Define, analyse and manage communications budgets and link performance, including RF performance, data rates, margins and operational constraints.
  • Support Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA) and Fault Detection, Isolation, Recovery (FDIR) activities to ensure communications subsystem robustness, fault detection and safe recovery during mission operations.
  • Coordinate with systems engineering, avionics, ground segment, operations and other subsystem teams to define Concept of Operations, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), development plans and verification approaches at subsystem and system level.
  • Plan, prepare and conduct communications subsystem and spacecraft-level verification activities, including RF testing, electrical testing, environmental testing and support to Assembly, Integration and Verification (AIV) campaigns.
  • Work with UK-based ground segment and mission operations teams to support end-to-end communications testing, operational readiness and live mission operations globally.
  • Review communications equipment, RF unit designs, circuit designs and PCB implementations to confirm they are suitable for their intended spacecraft function and operational environment.
  • Engage with partners and suppliers for the provision of communications equipment, supporting procurement engineers with specification, trade-off, selection and review of supplier deliverables against project milestones.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, test evidence and review outputs to support design reviews, project milestones and spacecraft acceptance activities.

Essential Skills & experience

  • Diploma; bachelor or master’s degree in electrical engineering or relevant engineering/science discipline.
  • 2+ years of commercial experience in space communication systems for satellites.
  • Experience in modelling and simulating RF space-to-ground links.
  • Experience in frequency licensing constraints (ITU) for old and new space applications.
  • Experience of RF circuits, RF systems design, and RF testing including environmental testing.
  • Experience in working with RF unit suppliers and supporting supplier reviews


Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience in physically testing hardware and handling flight equipment in a clean room environment.
  • Experience in GNSS RF links
  • Experience of analysis radiation tolerances and knowledge of radiation hardness assurance for Low Earth Orbit applications.
  • A basic knowledge in the following areas: debris removal, end-of-life, in-orbit servicing and digital space electronic design


Candidates for this role should also be able to gain, or already hold, UK Security Clearance to at least SC.



Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Opportunity to work with a highly talented, diverse & dynamic international team with cutting edge technology
  • Flexible working around core hours in a friendly and supportive environment
  • Optional 9/75 working pattern
  • Hybrid working available (dependent on individual role requirements)
  • 25 days holiday (increasing yearly up to a maximum of 28 days) + 8 days Bank Holiday
  • Life insurance and long-term sick pay
  • Private healthcare (taxable benefit)
  • Relocation allowance considered
  • State of the art office and cleanroom facility
  • Regular social events


Location

Astroscale UK (Harwell).

About Astroscale

Astroscale is the global leader in on-orbit servicing, dedicated to the secure and sustainable development of space. The company delivers a variety of innovative and scalable on-orbit servicing solutions, including life extension, refurbishment, upgrades, in-situ space situational awareness, end-of-life, and active debris removal. Since its first successful launch in March 2021, Astroscale has proven rendezvous and proximity operations technologies in orbit during the ELSA-d and ADRAS-J missions. Astroscale spacecraft have been selected for pioneering missions with JAXA, the U.S. Space Force, the European Space Agency, the UK Space Agency, and Eutelsat. As more satellite operators adopt on-orbit servicing to routinely inspect, relocate, remove, and extend the life of spacecraft, the potential of a circular space economy — and a future of no waste in space — is being unlocked. Headquartered in Japan, Astroscale has a global presence with subsidiaries in the United Kingdom, the United States, France, and Israel. Find out more about Astroscale at www.astroscale.com.

title: Product Manager
description:
Who We Are:

Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

The Role:

As a Product Manager, you independently own execution and continuous improvement within a defined product domain. You apply professional judgment to balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities, delivering high-quality enhancements and workflow improvements. You are a fully qualified product professional who works independently within your scope, solves diverse and sometimes ambiguous problems, and adapts existing approaches to meet evolving product and customer needs. This role requiresan understanding of clinical and provider workflows within electronic health record (eHR)environments and the ability to translate operational needs into scalable product solutionsWhile broader product strategy is set by Principal PMs/Product Directors, you exercise discretion and independent decision-making in managing your domain and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

Execution & Delivery

  • Independently own feature-level discovery, requirement definition, prioritization, and delivery within a defined product area.

  • Translate complex customer and business problems into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

  • Evaluate tradeoffs and make prioritization recommendations within your scope, exercising sound judgment with limited oversight.

  • Partner with engineering on planning, estimation, QA readiness, and release execution, adapting plans as needed based on new information.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to clarify requirements and ensure smooth releases.

  • Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders by adapting communication style and constructively navigating disagreements to drive product decisions.

  • Communicate changes, updates, and known issues clearly across the org.

  • Build productive working relationships with internal partners and, when appropriate, external stakeholders.

Discovery & Insights

  • Conduct customer interviews, feedback analysis, and usability assessments to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.

  • Analyze feature usage, performance data, and qualitative insights to diagnose issues and recommend solutions.

  • Adapt existing approaches or propose variations in response to non-routine or evolving product challenges.

  • Contribute informed recommendations to broader product strategy discussions.

Roadmap Contribution

  • Manage the backlog for your feature area, ensuring clarity and prioritization.

  • Provide input into the product roadmap through data and customer insight.

  • Support Senior PMs in evaluating tradeoffs and investment options.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze key metrics related to your product area.

  • Recommend improvements and optimizations to enhance usability and reliability.

  • Support root-cause analysis for defects or customer issues.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Degree & Years of Experience: Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or equivalent experience.

  • Familiarity with provider workflows, healthcare operations, and/or electronic healthrecord (eHR) systems

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate diverse inputs and exercise sound judgment.

  • Experience making prioritization decisions and tradeoff recommendations within a structured product environment.

  • Ability to adapt existing approaches to resolve ambiguous or non-routine product challenges.

  • Clear and persuasive communication skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Working knowledge of APIs and/or technical products; ability to navigate technical discussions with engineering partners.

  • Professional maturity to operate independently, with work reviewed at key milestones rather than continuously directed.

Benefits & Perks:

Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

Flexible work
Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life.

✈ Company-wide offsite
We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together.

🌴Time off that you’re expected to use
Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

💙Comprehensive health coverage
Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.
Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection).

401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

The Machinery Monitoring Engineer is part of the Reliability Engineering organization within the Chevron ENGINE Center and supports enterprise machinery monitoring and diagnostics for rotating equipment across Chevron Business Units and Capital Projects. This role proactively monitors machinery health and performance, analyzes equipment data, identifies abnormal trends and emerging failure modes, and recommends practical, risk-based actions to improve reliability, availability, maintainability, and operational performance.

The position partners with operations, maintenance, reliability, machinery engineering, digital, and site teams to mature predictive monitoring workflows, improve data quality, support deployment of monitoring tools, and enable faster intervention before equipment issues impact safety, production, or cost.

Key responsibilities:

  • Performs remote support of Chevron operations through exception-based monitoring of critical rotating and reciprocating machinery for multiple Business Units and business segments, as an extended member of the Machinery and Power Support Center.

  • Supports expansion of predictive analytics and other advanced analysis tools for machinery performance evaluation and early warning detection.

  • Engages with Business Units on equipment troubleshooting and identification of long-term trend deviation and equipment degradation.

  • Utilizes online condition monitoring programs to support asset health evaluations.

  • Supports data collection and reporting for benchmarking of critical rotating equipment reliability and efficiency metrics.

  • Supports data gathering for advanced machinery issues and collaboration with Subject Matter Experts. Proactively monitor rotating equipment health and performance for critical and high-impact machinery, including turbines, compressors, pumps, motors, gearboxes, generators, and supporting systems.

  • Analyze vibration, performance, process, lube oil, acoustic, temperature, pressure, inspection, maintenance, and operational data to identify abnormal trends, degradation patterns, and potential failure mechanisms.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering with 6-10 years of experience as a machinery analyst in an Oil and Gas operating facility

  • Extensive experience in rotating equipment operation, maintenance, system optimization and machinery condition monitoring analysis

title: Orthopedic Hand Surgeon
description:
The Department of Orthopedic Surgery at Mayo Clinic in Arizona is seeking a highly motivated, fellowship-trained hand and distal upper extremity surgeon with expertise in all aspects of hand, wrist, forearm, and elbow surgery to join our academic medical practice in the Division of Hand Surgery. The ideal candidate will have broad expertise in total elbow reconstruction, complex forearm trauma, and complex wrist and hand surgery. Microsurgical expertise is desired but not required. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a multidisciplinary division.

The Department of Orthopedic Surgery at Mayo Clinic is unified in its vision to improve the care of orthopedic patients, not just at Mayo Clinic but for patients nationwide and worldwide. Candidates must demonstrate a strong commitment to publishing high-quality, peer-reviewed original research and providing daily orthopedic education to residents and fellows. The position is 1.0 FTE clinical/surgical. The candidate is expected to build a differentiated practice that attracts patients from the US and abroad. As clinical practice matures, protected time for research and education can be earned, but the primary initial focus is establishing a differentiated, destination surgical practice.

Hand call is shared among division members, with current responsibility of approximately one week per month; this frequency is expected to decrease as the division grows. Residents and PAs provide first call coverage for emergency room and hospital consults at all times. Mayo Clinic Hospital is not a level one trauma center and is not part of a regional trauma system.

Must be board-certified/board-eligible in Orthopedic Surgery or Plastic Surgery with fellowship training and certificate of added qualifications in Hand Surgery, and eligible for medical licensure in the State of Arizona.

title: Head of ICT
description:
About Isis Central Sugar Mill

For more than 125 years, Isis Central Sugar Mill has played a vital role in Queensland's sugar industry, operating as a proud grower-owned organisation in the Wide Bay region.

Today, the organisation is entering an exciting new phase. Under a renewed executive team, Isis is strengthening its leadership capability, modernising systems and processes, and evolving its operating model to support long-term sustainability, improved collaboration and future growth. This includes enhancing corporate services, investing in new business systems and technology, and creating stronger partnerships between support functions and the broader business.

As part of this evolution, Isis is seeking an Head of ICT to join its Corporate Services team based in Childers. This newly created position offers the opportunity to shape the future of the organisation's technology capability while helping position technology as a trusted business partner across the organisation.

About the role

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Head of ICT will play an important role in the continued development of the organisation's technology capability.

You’ll lead a small team of four while working closely with leaders across the business to ensure technology supports operational outcomes, enables better decision making and delivers practical value to the organisation.

This is far more than a traditional ICT management role. As Isis continues to strengthen its systems, processes and corporate services capability, you’ll partner with stakeholders across the business to improve technology governance, strengthen cyber security, support the implementation of new business systems and identify practical technology solutions that enhance efficiency, collaboration and organisational performance.

Working closely with the CFO and leaders across the organisation, you’ll help shape a technology function that is increasingly focused on business partnering, continuous improvement and enabling better business outcomes through fit-for-purpose technology, sound governance and strong stakeholder engagement.

You’ll also provide leadership and mentoring to a capable team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and customer-focused service while supporting the ongoing evolution of the organisation's technology environment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading, mentoring and developing the technology team.
  • Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Strengthening cyber security, governance and technology risk management.
  • Supporting the implementation of new business systems and technology initiatives.
  • Identifying practical technology solutions that improve operational efficiency.
  • Partnering with leaders across the business to align technology with organisational priorities.
  • Contributing to broader organisational improvement and Corporate Services initiatives.
About you

You are an experienced technology professional with strong leadership capability and a genuine desire to use technology to improve how organisations operate.

This opportunity is likely to appeal to an emerging technology leader looking to take the next step in their career. You may currently be an ICT Team Leader, Infrastructure Lead, Applications Lead, Technology Business Partner, Digital Services Lead or another experienced technology professional ready to step into a broader management role. You may also be leading technology within a smaller organisation and looking for greater organisational exposure and the opportunity to influence business improvement initiatives.

Beyond your technical capability, you’re collaborative, commercially minded and naturally curious. You enjoy building relationships, developing people and partnering with stakeholders to identify practical technology solutions that deliver real business value.

You’re comfortable operating in a changing environment and motivated by the opportunity to help shape how technology supports the organisation into the future.

Experience within manufacturing, industrial, utilities, local government or other operational environments will be well regarded. Exposure to operational technology (OT), cyber security, business systems or technology-enabled transformation initiatives will also be viewed favourably. Most importantly, you’ll bring sound judgement, a practical mindset and a genuine passion for partnering with the business to achieve better outcomes.

Based in Childers, this position offers the opportunity to enjoy the lifestyle of the Wide Bay region while taking on a genuinely influential leadership role. Applications are encouraged from local candidates, however Isis Central Sugar Mill is committed to attracting outstanding people and is open to discussing relocation assistance, accommodation support or suitable flexible arrangements, including drive-in, drive-out (DIDO), for the right candidate.

If you’re looking to take the next step in your technology leadership career while helping shape the future of a respected regional organisation, we’d welcome your application.

title: Junior redovisningskonsult till Aspia, Eskilstuna
description:
Har du studerat ekonomi på universitet eller högskola och vill börja arbeta som redovisningskonsult? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig! Vi söker just nu juniora redovisningskonsulter till vårt kontor i Eskilstuna, där du blir en del av ett härligt gäng kollegor i ett bolag som värnar om balansen mellan arbete och privatliv. Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden samtidigt som du får en varierande och utvecklande roll där du får möjlighet att arbeta med kunder i olika branscher. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt uppdrag:

Att arbeta som redovisningskonsult hos oss på Aspia innebär att du får du vara med och utveckla våra kunders företagande, samtidigt som du själv utvecklas och utmanas tillsammans med dina kollegor i vardagen. I rollen som junior redovisningskonsult på Aspia har du ett omväxlande och självständigt arbete, där du arbetar på olika uppdrag åt våra kunder.

Vi arbetar alltid i team i våra uppdrag och du kommer därmed ha ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor. Tillsammans ser vi till att ge en högkvalitativ leverans till kund samt ger input och feedback till varandra utifrån respektive roll. Arbetet sker primärt på vårt eget kontor men kan också komma att ske ute hos kund.

Som junior redovisningskonsult, kommer dina arbetsuppgifter främst att bestå av:

  • Löpande bokföring
  • Upprättande av månadsbokslut
  • Månatliga avstämningar
  • Rapportering till kund

Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden. Vi utmanar dig, stöttar dig och tror på dig!

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

  • Studerar/har studerat ekonomi på universitet, högskola eller yrkeshögskola och kommer ta din examen senast januari 2027.
  • Vi ser gärna att du vid examen uppfyller de teoretiska kunskapskraven för att bli auktoriserad redovisningskonsult (för information, läs mer på far.se).
  • Vidare ser vi även att du behärskar svenska obehindrat i tal och skrift, samt har goda kunskaper i engelska.

För att du ska trivas och utvecklas i rollen som redovisningskonsult hos oss tror vi att du är en driven person som trivs i en relationsbyggande roll där kundvård, rådgivning och service är i fokus. Du trivs i mötet med kunden, har lätt för att etablera förtroendefulla kontakter och besitter en god kommunikativ förmåga.

Då vi arbetar i team tror vi att det är bra om du tycker om att arbeta nära dina kollegor, samt har förmågan att samarbeta med andra. Vidare ser vi även att du har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya situationer samt har förmågan att arbeta parallellt med flera uppgifter.

Du erbjuds!

Vårt mål på Aspia är att ge dig som medarbetare den bästa tiden i din karriär och vi är måna om balansen mellan privatliv och arbete. Hos oss får du ett arbete med frihet under ansvar och flexibel arbetstid, kollektivavtal och bra förmåner. Vi tycker att det är viktigt att du känner dig stimulerad i din roll och arbetar därför strukturerat med medarbetarsamtal där du sätter mål och planer för din utveckling. Sist, men inte minst, får du ett härligt gäng kollegor med bred kompetens i ett socialt arbetsklimat!

Praktiskt om tjänsten:

  • Tjänsten är på heltid med tillträdesdatum i Januari 2027. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
  • Placeringsort: Eskilstuna

Låter det som en intressant tjänst för dig? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

Du ansöker enkelt genom att skicka in ditt CV och besvara våra urvalsfrågor direkt i vårt verktyg. Med hänsyn av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl.

Om du går vidare till nästa steg hos oss, kommer du att få en inbjudan till att genomföra två arbetspsykologiska tester. Testerna mäter logisk förmåga samt personliga egenskaper.

Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat genom hela vår rekryteringsprocess och gör en objektiv och samlad bedömning av din kompetens, erfarenhet och potential att växa i rollen.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Marketing Technology Architect, StreetEasy
description:
About the team

StreetEasy's GTM Systems Pod is the technical backbone of our Revenue Operations and Lifecycle Marketing & Operations organization, owning the platforms that power our marketing and sales motions — from lifecycle email and in-app messaging to CRM integrations and data pipelines. We sit at the intersection of Marketing, Product, Data, and Sales Operations, building scalable, automated experiences that drive engagement, conversion, and retention across consumer and B2B agent journeys.

About the role

The Senior Marketing Technology Architect, StreetEasy partners with marketing, engineering, and external vendors to design, integrate, and operate StreetEasy's lifecycle marketing technology stack — including Iterable, Hightouch, SparkPost, and HubSpot. This role leads complex, cross-functional technical programs from discovery through implementation, aligning data, systems, and stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for StreetEasy's marketing ecosystem.

You will get to

  • Lead end-to-end technical programs for StreetEasy's MarTech platforms — Iterable, Hightouch, SparkPost, HubSpot — from requirements and planning through implementation, launch, and ongoing optimization.
  • Configure, integrate, and operate marketing technology platforms to enable centralized audience management, campaign execution, and reporting, including data contracts, event schemas, and reverse ETL sync cadences.
  • Design and manage data flows and ETL processes connecting marketing platforms to Databricks, Salesforce, and Airbyte, ensuring data quality, governance, and timely availability.
  • Coordinate cross-team delivery by aligning backlogs, sprint schedules, and release plans across marketing, engineering, data, and vendor teams, resolving dependencies and risks proactively.
  • Own the vendor relationships across these owned systems, overseeing our individual tool usage, budgets and evaluating the stack as a whole. At times, this may include overseeing contractors.
  • Document and standardize technical and operational processes for marketing technology, identifying automation opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

​- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing technology, technical program management, software engineering, data engineering, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.
  • Experience working with modern marketing technology stacks — such as Iterable, Braze, Hightouch, HubSpot, or Marketo — and integrating them with internal systems including CRM and data warehouse platforms (e.g. Databricks).
  • Experience delivering complex, data-intensive programs in an agile or iterative environment, including coordinating multiple teams and managing technical dependencies.
  • You bring a high-ownership, curious, and pragmatic mindset: making well-reasoned decisions amid ambiguity, staying ahead of platform and vendor changes, proactively troubleshooting issues, translating technical trade-offs for cross-functional partners, and sharing knowledge early so the whole team moves faster.
  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Get to know us

description:

Your role and responsibilities

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute service work as per work instructions and in accordance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. Each day, you will deliver quality customer service and executing service work as per customer order and expectation. You will ensure customer retention by effectively communicating the service work timeline and expectations.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

    on-site troubleshooting within certified areas.

title: Head of DevOps
description:
Head of DevOps | Azure, Terraform, CI/CD Leadership | UK Insurer Modernising a 40-Strong DevOps Function

  • Salary: £120,000 to £135,000, plus up to 20% annual bonus and a strong corporate benefits package
  • Location: London, hybrid (2 to 3 days in the office), plus roughly a day a fortnight at their IT hub in Sussex

You'll run the DevOps and automation function that keeps a UK insurer's technology delivery moving, a team of around 40 people the business treats as its engine room. Three team leads report to you across the UK and India, looking after the DevOps engineers embedded in the development squads, while four automation product owners cover areas like observability and platform engineering. This is a leadership seat, focused on how the team is structured, deployed and grown as the business changes, so your time goes on people, delivery and direction rather than the pipelines themselves.

The company is a long-established UK insurer with thousands of staff, a few years into a serious push on DevOps and automation. Around 70% of the estate is still legacy technology, so there's plenty to modernise. The function supports roughly 300 developers and a test team of about 70, with DevOps engineers currently deployed out to each development team to run their pipelines. It's a regulated environment (FCA), so governance and release reliability count for as much as speed.

They want someone who has led DevOps inside an end-user organisation rather than a career built inside an offshore outsourcer, and who understands DevOps delivered alongside developers, not pure cloud or infrastructure work. If that's you, this is a broad, senior remit at a business that's investing properly in the area.

What They're Looking For:
  • Leadership of a sizeable DevOps function spread across the UK and offshore India
  • DevOps engineering delivered inside development teams, rather than pure cloud or infrastructure DevOps
  • An enterprise or in-house background, not a career built inside an offshore outsourcer
  • Azure
  • CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Third-party and vendor management
  • 10+ years across DevOps and tooling or automation

What You'll Work With:
  • Ansible
  • Self-service environment provisioning
  • PaaS and IaaS platforms
  • CI/CD governance and release management
  • A large legacy estate part-way through modernisation
  • UK and India engineering teams plus offshore delivery partners

Nice to Haves:
  • Insurance, banking or other regulated-sector experience
  • Azure certifications
  • ITIL or Agile certifications
  • Experience in large, matrix-managed global organisations

Why Join?

You'll own a 40-person function end to end, with a budget of around £1 to £1.5m and real say over how the operating model develops as the business modernises. The brief is wide: strategy and roadmap, day-to-day delivery, major programme work, vendor management and budget.

If this is your kind of leadership role, apply and I'll call you to talk it through.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
At AustralianSuper, we truly care about our colleagues.​ We know work and life are intertwined. That’s why we support the diverse needs of everyone and have policies that enable us all to thrive and be truly flexible. We ensure diversity is celebrated for the opportunity it provides us all to learn and grow and deliver better outcomes for members. We are dedicated to building a high-performance environment underpinned by a strong risk culture, ensuring we deliver the best outcomes for our members.


The Risk Analyst is a key member of the Line 1 Risk team for the Member Domain, supporting a range of operational risk responsibilities across incidents, breaches, controls, reporting and the GRC system. The role works within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, shaped by a complex regulatory landscape.

Your New Role

Reporting to the Manager, Incidents, this role will support the Governance & Accountability team to ensure risk is managed in accordance with the Fund Enterprise Risk Management Framework. You will also help manage incidents and breaches in line with Fund and regulatory compliance obligations, support root cause analysis, and contribute to control enhancements and data integrity across risk reporting.

Key duties include but not limited to;

  • Working directly with incident owners, conduct initial investigations and gather adequate information to understand the nature and impact of incidents so that appropriate decisions can be made at the management and resolution of incidents.
  • Undertake root cause analysis and identify process or control improvement opportunities, where applicable.
  • Help the business identify and develop sustainable and commercial solutions for implementation that mitigate further incidents occurring.
  • Proactively monitor incidents to ensure they are appropriately managed, and all key activities have been completed within expected timeframes and to the required standard.
  • Ensure incident and breach reporting data integrity to enable accurate reporting and assist with generating insights that will enable improved decision making.
  • Execute control design and operating effectiveness testing including the identification and implementation of uplift recommendations.
  • Identification and design of controls to mitigate risks and/or fulfill obligations.
  • Assist in preparing periodic operational risk reporting and/or specific incident management reporting for various functions.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience in Operational Risk, Compliance, Internal or External Audit, or Fraud Management, preferably in superannuation or financial services.
  • Experience in incident, breach and/or fraud management will be highly regarded.
  • Working knowledge of risk and compliance frameworks, including incident and breach management.
  • Good understanding of controls management practices, including root cause analysis.
  • Critical thinking, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate complex factual scenarios in an easily digestible manner.
  • Strong written, oral communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present ideas, perspectives and issues to a range of audiences including non-risk colleagues, 2nd line colleagues and senior stakeholders
  • High level of personal integrity and the ability to professionally handle confidential matters.
  • Commercially astute, with the ability to offer pragmatic advice based on sound risk management principles.
  • Hold an accreditation in Risk Management from a recognised body like Risk Management Institute of Australasia (RMIA) or Governance Institute of Australia (GIA), or be willing to obtain one after joining AustralianSuper.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and translate external regulatory requirements to shape business outcomes.


Life at AustralianSuper

AustralianSuper is committed to colleague development, and we support our people with ongoing learning, coaching and training, as well as career opportunities across our expanding global organisation. We offer generous leave entitlements and promote a blended working environment in which all roles can flex, and we’re happy to discuss what this looks like for you.

We cultivate a workplace that champions safety, respect, inclusiveness and diversity. We are committed to supporting our diverse workforce in a way that is inclusive and embraces diversity in all its forms. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process or the role, please let our recruitment team know.

What’s Next

Apply now, if you share our values of Energy, Integrity, Generosity of Spirit and Excellent Outcomes and would like the opportunity to work in a challenging, growing and rapidly evolving team to deliver outstanding results.
