title: Member of Technical Staff 4 (Core Data Path)
description:
The Opportunity

This is a key engineering role in the Core Data Path (CDP) team, which maintains and evolves the Nutanix Distributed Storage Fabric (NDSF) – the foundational storage layer that powers Nutanix hyperconverged and hybrid cloud infrastructure.

As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, you will work on Stargate, the data engine of NDSF. Stargate handles IO requests, data placement, dedupe, compression, encryption, resiliency, and healing from failures. The work sits close to the core of the product and directly impacts performance, reliability, scale, and customer experience.

We are looking for engineers who combine strong systems fundamentals with ownership, sound design judgment, and the ability to deliver high-quality enterprise software in a complex distributed system.

Your Role

  • Design, implement, and deliver reliable, efficient, high-performance software for large-scale enterprise and hybrid cloud storage systems.

  • Own medium-to-large feature areas end to end, from problem definition and design through implementation, validation, performance analysis, rollout, and production support.

  • Develop a deep understanding of NDSF internals and use that context to build simple, robust solutions for customer and product requirements.

  • Work on performance, scale-out behavior, availability, resiliency, and failure handling in a distributed storage architecture.

  • Debug complex production and test issues across distributed components, using data, logs, metrics, and strong systems reasoning.

  • Collaborate closely with development, test, documentation, support, product management, and customer-facing teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging guidance, and clear technical communication.

    What You Will Bring

  • Strong OS, systems programming, and distributed systems fundamentals, with the ability to apply them to practical design and implementation tradeoffs.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining enterprise-quality software, preferably in C++ or another low-level systems language.

  • Proven ability to own non-trivial features or components in a production software system.

  • Good debugging skills for concurrency, performance, memory, correctness, and failure scenarios.

  • Ability to reason from first principles, break ambiguous problems into actionable pieces, and communicate design choices clearly.

  • A customer-first mindset and willingness to engage on production issues when engineering help is needed.

  • Hungry, humble, honest attitude with heart, and a strong sense of collaboration in a dynamic engineering team.

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Typically 9-12 years of relevant systems software experience.

Good To Have

  • Experience with distributed storage systems, filesystems, databases, consensus, replication, erasure coding, snapshots, caching, or data reduction technologies.

  • Experience with performance analysis, profiling, benchmarking, scale testing, or production incident debugging.

  • Familiarity with Linux internals, networking, concurrency primitives, memory management, or low-level IO paths.

  • Experience working with large C++ codebases and writing maintainable, testable, production-grade code.

About The Team

The CDP team was the first engineering team created at Nutanix and is responsible for the Nutanix Distributed Storage Fabric. We are hiring for the Stargate team, which is the data engine of the distributed file system.

The team works on some of the most interesting problems in storage: IO path design, data placement, resiliency, healing, performance, dedupe, compression, encryption, and scale. Even after many years of product maturity, the team continues to re-invent core architecture to use newer technologies and improve product capabilities.

Our primary technology stack is C++. We value deep ownership, clear design, simplicity, customer impact, and engineers who enjoy learning from one another.

How We Work

We work as a global team across regions and collaborate asynchronously as much as possible. Engineers are given autonomy and responsibility while working closely with stakeholders across engineering, support, product, and customer-facing teams.

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore or Pune. Team members are expected to work from the office at least 3 days a week to support collaboration, team alignment, and stronger mentorship - both learning from experienced engineers and helping mentor junior team members.

We focus on building infrastructure that delivers strong ROI for customers, whether through performance, reliability, simplicity, or operational savings. The best engineers on the team combine curiosity, ownership, technical depth, and humility.

title: Target2 Process Owner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Target2 Process Owner based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior, hands-on payment operations role responsible for establishing and owning the operational model for direct TARGET2 participation.
You will lead the transition from indirect participation to a fully controlled direct operating environment, covering processes, infrastructure, controls, and contingency planning.
The role spans the complete lifecycle from process design and UAT through BIC-by-BIC migration and stable business-as-usual operations.
You will work at the intersection of Payment Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Risk, and external financial infrastructure partners.
A major part of the role involves direct coordination with regulatory and scheme stakeholders, including central banking and payment infrastructure organizations.
You will play a critical role in protecting payment continuity, customer experience, regulatory readiness, and operational resilience.
This opportunity is ideal for an experienced payments professional who combines strong operational judgment with deep knowledge of SEPA, TARGET Services, and payment infrastructure.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end operational setup for direct TARGET2 participation, including process design, documentation, testing, migration, go-live readiness, and ongoing business-as-usual operations.
  • Establish and maintain payment operations processes covering SCT and SCT Inst recalls, payment inquiries and investigations, pacs.028 status requests, rejects, returns, refunds, and exception handling.
  • Own incoming and outgoing SWIFT enquiry processes, including MT199 and MT999 messages, RFIs, and relevant ISO 20022 messaging flows such as pacs, camt, and pain.
  • Define and operate processes for incoming RTGS payments, including payment monitoring, unmatched or pending items, exception handling, returns, Escrow arrangements, and confirmation of payment receipt.
  • Operate and maintain the T2 GUI and related U2A/A2A capabilities as a senior authorized user for payment tracking, returns, liquidity visibility, and manual or fallback actions.
  • Maintain TARGET operational infrastructure, including CRDM reference data, BICs, routing, accounts, users, roles, certificates, four-eyes authorization matrices, and production segregation of duties.
  • Lead the dual-route transition from indirect to direct participation, ensuring payments remain routable and traceable by BIC and payment path while defining criteria for retiring legacy dependencies.
  • Own the Payment Operations interface with daily reconciliation across MCA, RTGS DCA, and TIPS DCA, escalating liquidity-related issues that could affect payment execution or customer outcomes.
  • Redesign incident management and escalation procedures for direct participation, including operational detection, payment-impact assessment, DNB notifications, reporting, and evidence retention.
  • Define and maintain Payment Operations procedures for severe TARGET disruptions and the Eurosystem contingency solution, including training and testing evidence.
  • Coordinate directly with scheme and infrastructure stakeholders, central banking authorities, SWIFT/NSP providers, service providers, correspondent banks, and other financial institutions.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to test interfaces, identify operational and back-office requirements, and determine which processes should remain automated versus manual.
  • Ensure every critical payment process has a clearly assigned owner, documented procedures, defined controls, escalation paths, fallback mechanisms, and successful UAT evidence.
  • Drive a successful migration with no material customer impact and establish stable post-go-live operations without residual dependence on external sponsor-bank operational processes.

    • Requirements:

    • Minimum 3+ years of experience in payment operations within a bank, Electronic Money Institution (EMI), Payment Service Provider (PSP), or similar financial services environment.
    • Hands-on experience with SEPA payment schemes, particularly SCT and SCT Inst, and TARGET Services such as T2/RTGS and TIPS.
    • Strong practical knowledge of payment investigations, recalls, returns, refunds, and exception-management workflows.
    • Working knowledge of SWIFT and ISO 20022 messaging standards, including MT199, MT999, pacs, camt, and pain messages.
    • Experience operating financial infrastructure interfaces and tools directly, ideally including T2 GUI, CRDM, reconciliation systems, liquidity-monitoring platforms, and U2A/A2A actions.
    • Proven ability to design, document, and implement operational processes, including detailed SOPs, four-eyes controls, authorization matrices, escalation procedures, and audit-ready evidence.
    • Experience coordinating with regulators, central banks, scheme operators, SWIFT/NSP providers, service providers, correspondent banks, and other external stakeholders.
    • Ability to translate complex operational requirements into clear specifications for Product and Engineering teams and effectively challenge technical solutions when operational needs are not met.
    • Senior-level judgment and independence, with the ability to own operational sign-offs, incident escalation, regulatory reporting decisions, and risk-based decisions.
    • Familiarity with DNB/TARGET-NL requirements, the Instant Payments Regulation (IPR), and operational obligations applicable to EMI/PSD2 environments.
    • Strong understanding of payment operations, reconciliation, liquidity touchpoints, operational controls, and payment infrastructure resilience.
    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in regulatory, technical, and cross-border environments.
    • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to managing complex transitions and operational risks.
    • Experience with direct TARGET/RTGS/TIPS onboarding, sponsor-bank-to-direct-participation migration, or contingency and incident-management programs is a strong advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation aligned with experience, location, and the scope of the role.
      • Opportunity to make a direct impact on a critical financial infrastructure transition and the evolution of a growing financial technology platform.
      • Flexible remote or hybrid working arrangements across Europe.
      • Opportunity to work from the Netherlands, Spain, Poland, or potentially under a freelance arrangement in other countries, preferably within the CEST or adjacent time zones.
      • Stock options program designed to give team members an ownership stake in the company's growth.
      • Opportunities for continuous professional and personal development.
      • Supportive, modern, friendly, and environmentally conscious working culture.
      • Work & Swim program offering the opportunity to spend a month working from a corporate apartment in Cyprus.
      • International exposure through collaboration with regulators, payment schemes, banks, technology teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Europe.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to equal opportunity and welcoming people from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

title: AI Engineer - Deep Learning Research (Manager)
description:
At Globe, our goal is to create a wonderful world for our people, business, and nation. By uniting people of passion who believe they can make a difference, we are confident that we can achieve this goal.

Job Description

The AI Transformation and Research role is a strategically focused AI engineer responsible for identifying emerging AI opportunities, evaluating new models and technologies, and shaping the organization’s AI direction through evidence-based research, experimentation, and portfolio recommendations.

The role bridges the gap between enterprise AI strategy and technical reality by assessing what is worth adopting, what should be monitored, what should be tested, and what should not be pursued. It supports decision-making across the AI ecosystem by producing objective comparisons of closed-source and open-source models, vendor offerings, deployment patterns, and cost-performance tradeoffs.

This role is not primarily responsible for building production solutions or delivering business-unit implementations. Instead, it provides the research, validation, and strategic recommendations that help the broader AI team decide where to invest, what to scale, and how to design future AI capabilities.

The role requires strong analytical judgment, structured research capability, hands-on understanding of LLMs and AI infrastructure, and the ability to translate technical findings into clear business and executive recommendations. It also requires close collaboration with AI Engineering, AI FDE, Architecture, Operations, and governance teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and operational realities.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor the AI landscape for new models, platforms, vendors, tools, techniques, and research developments.

  • Maintain a model landscape / model platter covering leading closed-source, open-source, and locally hosted model options.

  • Evaluate vendor claims and conduct structured benchmarks and comparative evaluations of AI models and platforms.

  • Assess fit-for-purpose use of models for selected enterprise workloads, including when smaller, open, or locally hosted models may be better.

  • Design and run controlled experiments, translate findings into recommendations, and support governance, handoff, and executive reporting.

  • Design and develop prototypes and experimental AI solutions that can be transitioned to production.

  • Provide regular technical updates and findings to FDE for solution shaping.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Master’s degree in AI, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.

  • At least 3 years of experience in AI, data science, software engineering, technology research, or technical consulting.

  • Demonstrable experience evaluating AI solutions, models, tools, or platforms.

  • Strong ability to translate technical findings into clear recommendations.

  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with cloud AI platforms, LLMs, and enterprise technology environments.

  • Strong documentation and presentation skills.

  • Experience with experimental thinking, benchmarking, or structured analysis is preferred.

  • Hands-on technical capability is a plus, especially for model testing and experimentation.



SKILLS:

Soft skills:

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem solving

  • Clear executive communication and concise writing

  • Ability to explain complex AI topics in business language

  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

  • Curiosity, judgment, and independent thinking

  • Ability to work in ambiguous and fast-changing environments

Hard skills:

  • LLMs, model evaluation, and benchmarking

  • Understanding of open-source and closed-source model ecosystems

  • Python and basic experimentation workflow

  • AI infrastructure literacy, including cloud deployment concepts

  • Prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, and model comparison concepts

  • Data analysis and evaluation methods

  • Familiarity with GCP and/or other major cloud AI platforms

title: Principal Analyst - Enforcement
description:
ASX: Powering Australia's financial markets

Why join the ASX?

When you join ASX, you’re joining a company with a strong purpose – to power a stronger economic future by enabling a fair and dynamic marketplace for all.

In your new role, you’ll be part of a leading global securities exchange with a strong brand. We are known for being a trusted market operator and an exciting data hub.

Want to know why we are a great place to work, click on the link to learn more.

www.asx.com.au/about/careers/a-great-place-to-work

We are more than a securities exchange!

The ASX team brings together talented people from a diverse range of disciplines.

We run critical market infrastructure, with 1 in 3 people employed within technology. Yet we have a unique complexity of roles across a range of disciplines such as operations, program delivery, financial products, investor engagement, risk and compliance.

We’re proud to foster a workplace where diversity is celebrated and inclusion is part of our everyday culture. Our employee-led networks champion LGBTIQ+ inclusion, promote gender equality, accessibility and wellbeing, inspire giving and volunteering, and celebrate cultural and religious events, creating a sense of belonging for all. As an AWEI Bronze employer and member of the Champions of Change Coalition for gender equality, we’re committed to a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

ASX Enforcement is a specialist function established by ASX, and operating within ASX Supervision, to enforce compliance with the ASX Group Operating Rules by participants and plays a key role in ensuring ASX meets its licence obligations. The ASX Enforcement team is responsible for bringing enforcement action against market, clearing and settlement participants for breaches of ASX's Operating Rules. The Head of Enforcement is also responsible for setting and implementing the strategic direction for enforcing non-compliance with the ASX Listing Rules by listed entities.

In this role, as a principal analyst you will contribute to the work of the ASX Enforcement team by:

  • Working with Participant Supervision to assist with participant investigations, including but not limited to:

    • Reviewing allegations, complaints, referrals and self-reported breaches of the ASX Operating Rules.

    • Gathering, analysing and assessing information and evidence to establish relevant facts and circumstances.

    • Investigating potential instances of non-compliance with the ASX Operating Rules and Procedures.

    • Preparing clear, evidence-based investigation reports, findings and recommendations.

    • Drafting tailored correspondence and submissions for participants, internal stakeholders and external legal advisers.

    • Maintaining objective, professional and procedurally fair engagement with participants throughout investigations and enforcement action.

    • Maintaining timely and accurate investigation and enforcement action records.

    • Contributing to periodic reporting on participant enforcement outcomes and emerging trends and risks.

    • Driving participant compliance and accountability

    • Assisting Participant Supervision on monitoring remediation activities and implementation of early corrective actions through enforcement intervention.

    • Promoting compliance with the ASX Operating Rules and Participant Supervision framework through timely, effective and proportionate enforcement actions.

    • Supporting policy, process improvement and strategic initiatives

    • Assisting in enhancing and maintaining participant supervision and enforcement processes, case management practices and reporting frameworks.

    • Contributing to supervision-led projects, regulatory change initiatives and continuous improvement activities.

    • Supporting the delivery of division wide strategic compliance initiatives.

    • Supporting participant education and engagement

    • Contributing to educational activities that assist participants in understanding and meeting their obligations.

    • Sharing knowledge and regulatory insights with internal stakeholders.

    • Contributing to the development of guidance materials and supervision communications.

    • Delivering capability uplift and knowledge sharing

    • Contributing to knowledge sharing within enforcement and internal stakeholders.

    • Supporting cross-training activities to ensure appropriate coverage across the team and the division.

    • Assisting in developing technical knowledge and enforcement capability within the team.

Your experience and qualifications:

Must have:

  • A tertiary qualification in law, accounting, finance, business, economics or related disciplines

  • At least 7 years’ relevant industry or professional experience

  • Good understanding of Australia’s financial markets and operations or international comparative covering equities, derivatives, OTC, clearing and settlement

  • Practical knowledge of the competencies required to operate in the ASX markets and clearing and settlement facilities (or international comparison)

  • Practical knowledge of compliance and risk methodologies

  • Highly developed analytical, investigative and problem-solving abilities

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities and experience, and how you’ll help us to live our values. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the criteria of this role.

If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process to help you present your best self, please let us know at careers@asx.com.au.

At ASX Group, our diverse workforce is essential to build and maintain a fair and dynamic marketplace. We support flexible working and offer hybrid working options. Even if our roles are advertised as full-time, we encourage you to apply if you are interested in part-time or other flexible working arrangements.

We will arrange for successful candidates to have background checks, including reference and police checks, completed as part of the on-boarding process.

To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorised to work in Australia on a permanent basis without any restrictions.

title: Carer - Casual
description:
Transform lives, every single day

Would you like to use your compassion and care for greater impact? At Anglicare Sydney, you can. And together, we will.

We’re a well-respected not-for-profit that’s been serving society’s most vulnerable for more than 170 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for the 40,000+ people who rely on our person-centred support.

As a Carer, you will make a difference that enriches lives and strengthens communities. In return for your dedication, you'll find genuine support, rewarding career opportunities, and the balance you need to thrive in all areas of your life.

Your opportunity

As a Carer at Anglicare Sydney, you will provide high quality care and support to residents, helping them live with dignity and purpose. You will assist with daily tasks, provide emotional support, and offer companionship to residents. You will ensure the physical comfort and emotional health of our residents are met in a caring and nurturing environment.

With kindness and understanding, you will:

  • Provide personal care assistance, including showering, dressing, grooming and feeding.

  • Support residents with mobility and physical assistance.

  • Provide companionship and emotional support.

  • Monitor and document residents’ progress, ensuring their needs and preferences are met.

  • Work collaboratively with healthcare professionals to deliver person-centred care while fostering a positive and inclusive environment within the facility.

What you’ll bring

You are a kind-hearted, patient and respectful person who is passionate about enhancing the lives of older people. You share our organisational values of integrity, justice, compassion and excellence, and bring them to everything you do.

To thrive in this role, you will need:

  • A Certificate III in Aged Care, Individual Support or equivalent qualification, a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a similar role.

  • An NDIS Worker Screening Check Clearance ID.

  • All required qualifications must be recognised under the Australian Qualifications Framework.

You will also have:

  • A passion for working with older people and enhancing their quality of life.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.

  • An understanding of the importance of maintaining residents’ dignity and independence.

  • Alignment with Anglicare’s Christian ethos and values.

Auckland | On-site | Full Time | Competitive pay & great perks

Lead live broadcast delivery and shape the performance, quality, and consistency of Trackside’s on-air product.

You’ll stay hands-on directing high-quality racing and studio coverage on Trackside, while leading the team responsible for delivering seamless broadcast operations across our Australian channels. Great to Have

  • Experience in racing or sports broadcasting
  • Background in rostering, workforce planning, or shift-based environments
  • Experience developing training materials, style guides, or operational documentation

What You’ll Gain

You’ll join a connected, high-energy environment where sport, entertainment, collaboration, and momentum are part of the everyday.

  • Reward: Competitive pay and great perks, including retailer discounts
  • Flexibility: Personal days off to balance life and work
  • Growth: Build your leadership capability while deepening expertise in live broadcast delivery, training, and operational planning
  • Exposure: Work across Trackside, TAB, Ladbrokes, and neds, collaborating with production teams, presenters, and national broadcast operations
  • People: Lead a specialist broadcast team in a hands-on environment where support, accountability, and shared standards drive performance
  • Perks: Comprehensive wellbeing support, free breakfast and snacks, and an office worth showing up to - think pool table, sports on TVs, and a modern space designed for you

It’s a place to build your skills, connect with great people, and grow your potential through work that genuinely matters.

There’s nothing like it.

description:

  • Du er fødevare- og sikkerhedsansvarlig i egen afdeling og sikrer, at alle gældende hygiejne-, fødevare- og sikkerhedsstandarder overholdes til enhver tid​​​

HVEM ER DU?

  • Du er en erfaren Head Chef, Executive Chef eller Gastronomisk Chef med baggrund fra signatur- og boutiquehoteller eller restauranter med flere forskellige koncepter i multibrand-miljøer – gerne med erfaring i opstart af nye køkkener​

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Project description

The client has an installed base of hundreds of scanner systems worldwide. In order to meet up-time contract agreements, the system downtime must be kept to an absolute minimum. The traditional way to diagnose a system failure is to send engineers to a failing machine and let them execute the diagnostics and calibration procedures using a set of procedures and software tools. The client is about to change that way of working by introducing a server on-site that continuously monitors all scanners in a customer domain. The server must detect (upcoming) system failure and identify what corrective actions are needed via a knowledge and procedure database. In the calibration phase, this server will initiate the required service actions on the scanner with correct settings and timings (which is highly configuration dependent) The software running on the server is Java based. Core aspects of the design will be database management and information distribution (worldwide), performance efficient data collection schemes and data to information transitions.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 5+ years' experience with Java (developing backend/web applications, Java), Java 21 experience Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC / REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) integration Knowledge/experience with designing and/or implementing REST APIs Familiarity with CI/CD, build pipelines (Bamboo, Jenkins, etc.) Oracle/Postgres Database, Liquibase Apache Kafka (Spring Kafka) Protocol Buffers & gRPC, OpenAPI contract-first Maven (multi-module) JUnit 5, Mockito, Spring Boot Test, Cucumber, Testcontainers Bachelor Degree

description:

Nayara Energy operates in India for India driven by a relentless commitment to fuel the nation's energy aspirations. Delivering value for all our stakeholders is at the very core of our beliefs and we are committed to providing the energy that fuels the dreams of our employees, customers, partners and communities.

Job Purpose: To monitor, control, and optimize process parameters to achieve design objectives and operational excellence. Acts as the first responder during process emergencies and ensures efficient, safe, and compliant panel operations.

Quality Management System

  • Execute shift activities as directed by Shift In-Charge.
  • Align with business planning (short, medium, long term).
  • Adjust process parameters to meet yield targets and products quality targets.
  • Read the previous shifts’ logs (Log of all days / hours of his absence) and note down key issues viz., quality issues, continuing maintenance jobs etc., needing special attention.
  • To implement most cost economical operation to meet Refinery steam, power and feed water demand as well power export/ import to state grid as per plan in close coordination with SIC.
  • Understanding Operating costs and trying to Optimize in planned activities. Ensure maximum utilisation of cheaper fuel.

Systems, Policies & Procedures

  • Implement unit-specific panel operation SOPs Emergency SOPs and checklists.
  • Implement refinery integrated management procedures.
  • Recommend improvements to systems and procedures.

Panel Operations Management

  • Direct field officers for parameter control activities.
  • Observes instruments, trends, and alarms on the control panel to constantly monitor critical parameters within IOW.
  • Manages start up and shut down of unit in a safe and controlled manner as per procedures.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and report process deviations or equipment malfunctions.
  • Ensure sampling schedule compliance and review lab results.
  • Maintain product quality and yield as per EPS guidance.
  • Ensure safety interlocks are operational.
  • Participation in Management of Change (MOC) & project pre-commissioning, commissioning, and execution.
  • Participation of In-Plant training.
  • Report process & safety Near misses, substandard condition, and act
  • Implementation of unit specific operational and safety checklist
  • Ensures the compliance to equipment changeover Schedules.
  • Monitors the Process parameters to ensure that the business objectives of the plant are achieved while controlling the process parameters in line with the guidelines / Instructions received from the Shift In Charge & critical parameters within IOW.
  • Analyze previous shift logs for continuity and issue tracking.

MIS & Documentation

  • Prepare and analyse department MIS reports for decision-making.
  • Maintain logs of operational changes and maintenance activities.
  • Maintain the Logs for all the changes carried out during the shift.
  • Record of alarms and optimising alarms in coordination with SIC/ AAM.
  • Maintain the records of the critical jobs that are being carried out by Maintenance during the shift, continuing from the previous shift and the jobs envisaged to be carried out in the next shift.

OHSMS – Health, Safety & Welfare

  • Accept/reject work permits based on safety compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to HSEF procedures and emergency protocols.
  • Manage safe shutdown/start-up during utility or equipment failures.
  • Comply with ERDMP guidelines during emergencies.

Environment Management System

  • Ensure environmental compliance and SOP adherence.

Energy Management System (ISO 50001:2018)

description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin esihenkilömme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Kioskiesihenkilönä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Huolehdit arjen sujuvuudesta, tiimin vetämisestä ja kioskin tuloksellisesta toiminnasta.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme Seinäjoki Kasperi Kasperinviita 15 R-kioskille kioskiesihenkilöä. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 37,5 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta esihenkilö - ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

• Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia (jos sinulla ei vielä passia ole, voit suorittaa sen koeajan puitteissa)

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

title: Myyjä, Seinäjoki Kasperi Kasperinviita 15
description:
Hymyiletkö vielä silloinkin, kun kiire painaa päälle? Sytytkö asiakaskohtaamisista ja haluat tehdä arjesta helpompaa – sekä itsellesi että muille? Jos nyökkäilit, saatat olla seuraava R‑kioskin myyjämme.

R‑kioskilla asiakkaamme tulevat hakemaan nopeutta, mutkattomuutta ja hyvää fiilistä. Myyjänä olet tämän kokemuksen ydin: palvelun ammattilainen, joka osaa ratkaista tilanteet tyynesti ja toimia omatoimisesti myös silloin, kun tehtäviä on monta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

  • Palvelet asiakkaita ystävällisesti ja tehokkaasti – myös ruuhkahetkinä.
  • Hallitset kassatyöskentelyn, tuotteet, palvelut ja lisämyynnin tilanteet rennolla otteella.
  • Esittelet ja suosittelet rohkeasti uutuuksia sekä kampanjatuotteita.
  • Huolehdit, että kioski on siisti, viihtyisä ja hyllyt runsaat.
  • Osallistut arjen sujuvuuteen: asiakkaat, työkaverit ja sinä viihdytte kioskilla yhtä lailla.

Miksi juuri sinä sopisit meille?

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja rohkea tarttumaan tehtäviin.
  • Pystyt ratkomaan ongelmatilanteita nopeasti ja palveluasenteella.
  • Sykähdyt vauhdikkaasta työstä ja nautit siitä, että jokainen päivä on erilainen.
  • Haluat tehdä työtä vastuullisesti – meillä se näkyy sekä valikoimassa että arjen teoissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana opit työn perusteet ja käytännöt.
  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun ammattilaiseksi.
  • Halutessasi väylän kohti esihenkilö- tai yrittäjäpolkua: voit hakea Trainee‑valmennusohjelmaamme ja edetä aina oman R‑kioskin yrittäjäksi asti.

Haemme Seinäjoki Kasperi Kasperinviita 15 R-kioskille myyjää. Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Toivomme että pystyt työskentelemään keskimäärin 26 h/vko ja pystyt aloittamaan työt mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan!

Arvostamme

• Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä

• Kiinnostusta kahvila- ja delimaailmaan

• Kokemusta pelimyynnistä ja postitoiminnoista

Edellytämme

• Ystävällistä ja iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

• Reipasta myyntihenkisyyttä

• Itsenäistä ja vastuullista otetta työhön

• Hygieniapassia (jos sinulla ei vielä passia ole, voit suorittaa sen koeajan puitteissa)

• Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

• Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

• Tarkastamme luottotiedot osana rekrytointiprosessia

title: Senior Software Engineer - Commercial Trading
description:
Description

Summary

As part of the M&S Software Engineering team, you’ll be joining a well-loved historic brand, working on solutions that serve millions of loyal customers and thousands of colleagues. With ethical values that run right through the company’s core and technology leaders that truly understand software engineering, it’s an exciting time as we’re redefining ourselves into a digital-first and engineering-led organisation, with the quality of our engineering team being a key differentiator.

As a Staff Software Engineer within our Commercial Trading domain, your expertise will help drive this transformation by creating robust, scalable and resilient solutions that deliver value across the business. You’ll play a key role in shaping technical direction, improving engineering standards and ensuring our products and platforms are built with strong observability, operational excellence and best-in-class engineering practices.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible.

What You'll Do

Your key accountabilities will include:

  • Develop, test and debug high-quality software solutions, leading by example and championing engineering best practices across the team.
  • Provide technical leadership within projects, guiding engineers on solution design, implementation approaches and software engineering standards.
  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable, adaptable software solutions and third-party integrations, partnering closely with Architecture teams where appropriate.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to technical standards, maintainability, automated testing strategies and high-quality code, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers and engineers to understand business challenges and design effective technology solutions.
  • Mentor engineers across the team, sharing knowledge and experience to support their technical growth and career development.
  • Drive operational excellence through effective monitoring, alerting, incident response processes and continuous learning from operational events.

Who You Are

Your skills and experience will include:

  • Proven track record in developing high-performing, robust backend systems and integrations, with a focus on scalability, optimisation and reliability.
  • Deep understanding of software engineering principles, patterns and practices, applied to the development of maintainable, adaptable and resilient systems.
  • Strong understanding of automated testing approaches and associated toolsets, applied effectively across unit, integration and system testing levels.
  • Technical versatility and proficiency across relevant technologies and tools, including Java, PL/SQL, JavaScript, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in designing, building and operating scalable cloud-native applications with a strong focus on performance, security and resilience.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and drive alignment across stakeholders.
  • A collaborative and mentoring mindset, with a genuine passion for sharing knowledge and helping engineers develop and achieve their potential.

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of the retail domain, particularly product lifecycle management, merchandising, commercial trading, assortment planning or sales planning, would be advantageous but is not essential.

Tech Stack

The team uses a variety of modern technologies, including:

  • Backend: Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Micronaut
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Angular
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure Cloud, Kubernetes
  • Observability: Dynatrace
  • Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
  • Caching & Performance: Ignite, Redis

What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger – helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding:

  • 20% colleague discount on all M&S products and many third-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation.
  • Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more.
  • Discretionary bonus schemes linked to your performance and ours.
  • Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future.
  • Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one.
  • Exclusive perks and savings through our M&S Choices portal.
  • Market-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave.
  • 24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services.
  • One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you.

Everyone’s Welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

If you feel you'd benefit from any support or reasonable adjustments during any stage of the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know when completing your application. This information will be picked up by our team, so we can try and put steps in place to help you be at your best through this process.

title: Social Creative
description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

Our business is scaling in the UK, US, Australia and Canada, and our amazing team is spread across Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our Social Creative, you’ll be one of the creative voices shaping our organic social presence — dreaming up ideas that are unmistakably Who Gives A Crap, then actually making them happen. You’re a writer first: someone who thinks in captions, scripts and copy before anything else. Most of your time (around 80%) is spent deep in our social channels: spotting what’s worth jumping on,finding the angle no one else has taken, and writing copy that sounds like a person, not a brand. The other 20% is broader creative work — pitching in on presentations, campaigns and other through-the-line projects as part of the Copy team, and alongside the wider Creative department.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Jumped into a weekly brainstorm to figure out which trends, formats and conversations we could jump on (and which we should steer clear of)
  • Found new ways to talk about our impact, connecting customers with the stories of people we're helping around the world
  • Wrote, shot and edited a short-form video on your phone, start to finish, for one of our channels
  • Pitched a handful of ideas for a product launch and helped bring the strongest one to life across platforms
  • Joined a cross-functional brief alongside an art director or designer for a piece of broader campaign work

Let’s talk about you

You can’t help but notice what’s working on the internet

You’re genuinely curious about internet culture — not just what’s trending, but why. You’ve got a maker’s instinct too: when an idea lands, you don’t just pitch it, you’re comfortable picking up a phone and shooting it yourself.

You’re a wizard with words

You can write a caption that’s short, sharp and sounds like a real person — and you know when a bit of brand tone of voice needs bending to work on a given platform. You get our particular flavour of silly, and you know it’s different from just being try-hard or worthy.

You’ve got a couple of years under your belt

This isn’t an entry-level gig. You can tell a good idea from a bad one without much hand-holding, and you’re comfortable taking loose direction and running with it.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

title: Junior redovisningskonsult till Aspia, Uppsala
description:
Har du studerat ekonomi på universitet eller högskola och vill börja arbeta som redovisningskonsult? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig! Vi söker just nu juniora redovisningskonsulter till vårt kontor i Uppsala, där du blir en del av ett härligt gäng kollegor i ett bolag som värnar om balansen mellan arbete och privatliv. Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden samtidigt som du får en varierande och utvecklande roll där du får möjlighet att arbeta med kunder i olika branscher. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt uppdrag:

Att arbeta som redovisningskonsult hos oss på Aspia innebär att du får du vara med och utveckla våra kunders företagande, samtidigt som du själv utvecklas och utmanas tillsammans med dina kollegor i vardagen. I rollen som junior redovisningskonsult på Aspia har du ett omväxlande och självständigt arbete, där du arbetar på olika uppdrag åt våra kunder.

Vi arbetar alltid i team i våra uppdrag och du kommer därmed ha ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor. Tillsammans ser vi till att ge en högkvalitativ leverans till kund samt ger input och feedback till varandra utifrån respektive roll. Arbetet sker primärt på vårt eget kontor men kan också komma att ske ute hos kund.

Som junior redovisningskonsult, kommer dina arbetsuppgifter främst att bestå av:

  • Löpande bokföring
  • Upprättande av månadsbokslut
  • Månatliga avstämningar
  • Rapportering till kund

Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden. Vi utmanar dig, stöttar dig och tror på dig!

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

  • Studerar/har studerat ekonomi på universitet, högskola eller yrkeshögskola och kommer ta din examen senast januari 2027.
  • Vi ser gärna att du vid examen uppfyller de teoretiska kunskapskraven för att bli auktoriserad redovisningskonsult (för information, läs mer på far.se).
  • Vidare ser vi även att du behärskar svenska obehindrat i tal och skrift, samt har goda kunskaper i engelska.

För att du ska trivas och utvecklas i rollen som redovisningskonsult hos oss tror vi att du är en driven person som trivs i en relationsbyggande roll där kundvård, rådgivning och service är i fokus. Du trivs i mötet med kunden, har lätt för att etablera förtroendefulla kontakter och besitter en god kommunikativ förmåga.

Då vi arbetar i team tror vi att det är bra om du tycker om att arbeta nära dina kollegor, samt har förmågan att samarbeta med andra. Vidare ser vi även att du har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya situationer samt har förmågan att arbeta parallellt med flera uppgifter.

Du erbjuds!

Vårt mål på Aspia är att ge dig som medarbetare den bästa tiden i din karriär och vi är måna om balansen mellan privatliv och arbete. Hos oss får du ett arbete med frihet under ansvar och flexibel arbetstid, kollektivavtal och bra förmåner. Vi tycker att det är viktigt att du känner dig stimulerad i din roll och arbetar därför strukturerat med medarbetarsamtal där du sätter mål och planer för din utveckling. Sist, men inte minst, får du ett härligt gäng kollegor med bred kompetens i ett socialt arbetsklimat!

Praktiskt om tjänsten:

  • Tjänsten är på heltid med tillträdesdatum i januari 2027/enligt överenskommelse.
  • Placeringsort: Uppsala

Låter det som en intressant tjänst för dig? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

Du ansöker enkelt genom att skicka in ditt CV och besvara våra urvalsfrågor direkt i vårt verktyg. Med hänsyn av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl.

Om du går vidare till nästa steg hos oss, kommer du att få en inbjudan till att genomföra två arbetspsykologiska tester. Testerna mäter logisk förmåga samt personliga egenskaper.

Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat genom hela vår rekryteringsprocess och gör en objektiv och samlad bedömning av din kompetens, erfarenhet och potential att växa i rollen.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

description:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. You will act as the technical authority and central hub for all data initiatives across the company, ensuring a cohesive, secure, and scalable data strategy.
By building this scalable technical foundation, you will pave the way for company-wide AI adoption. As the internal platform matures, your scope will likely expand to drive robust data and AI capabilities directly into our customer-facing products.

As a Data Engineering Lead, Agentic Infrastructure (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:
  • Build the foundation: Design, architect, and build our highly scalable internal data platform and core data warehouse, centralizing data across all internal tools and systems. Ensure that every data initiative goes through your team and aligns with our overarching architecture and scalability standards.
  • Lead & mentor: Provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, and hands-on mentorship to a high-impact team of engineers.
  • Drive company-wide AI adoption: Build the robust, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure required to power our internal AI initiatives, enabling intelligent tooling and automation.
  • Scale for the future: Establish a future-proof technical foundation that initially optimizes internal operations, with a clear roadmap to expand into core product features.
  • Establish operational excellence: Implement data governance, data lineage, observability, and strict quality controls to ensure the data platform is reliable and trusted.

    • What you will need to succeed in this role:
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, building modern data stacks, central data warehouses, and high-throughput data pipelines.
  • A track record of technically leading and elevating small teams while remaining deeply hands-on.
  • Proven ability to design company-wide data architectures and act as the principal technical decision-maker for complex data systems.
  • Strong understanding of how to structure, model, and pipeline data specifically to support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner with internal stakeholders to centralize and streamline all business data requests.

    We’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.

    Fast Growing, in All Aspects
    Sifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.

    Next-Gen Leaders & Insights
    Work alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.

title: Network Consultant
description:
Overview

Cathara Consulting is seeking a Network Consultant to support the client’s network and telecommunications services. Working with business representatives, managed service providers, vendors and technical stakeholders, the consultant will provide specialist network advice, hands-on transition support, technical guidance and stakeholder engagement to ensure solutions align with business requirements, technology standards and operational objectives.

The client is delivering a large-scale critical ICT infrastructure transformation program across more than 460 metropolitan, regional and remote sites. The program is modernising network and infrastructure services to provide a secure, resilient and scalable foundation for future digital services. The program includes replacing end-of-life assets, uplifting cyber security, improving service reliability, enabling strategic digital initiatives, remediating audit and compliance findings, and transitioning to contemporary managed infrastructure and support services.


Essential Skills

· Strong Cisco enterprise networking fundamentals, including hands-on Catalyst switching and practical Layer 2/3 troubleshooting in large campus environments.

· Foundational knowledge of Cisco SD-Access concepts, including fabric edge, border and control-plane roles, VXLAN, LISP and Security Group Tags.

· Experience supporting live production networks during transition, post-cutover or hypercare activities.

· Understanding of micro- and macro-segmentation in Cisco environments.

· Experience using endpoint information and traffic analysis to maintain accurate network-connected device records.

· Level 2/3 network or desktop support and systematic fault isolation experience.

· Experience configuring and installing routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs and QoS services.

· Experience monitoring network performance, availability and reliability.

· Demonstrated experience working within configuration and change management processes.

· Ability to work effectively with vendors, service providers and technical teams to resolve complex issues.


Desirable Skills and Experience

· Exposure to Cisco ISE, NetFlow, telemetry or operational technology visibility platforms such as xDome or similar.

· Experience supporting IoT devices, particularly within medical or clinical environments.

· Experience developing strategic program roadmaps and delivering engagements of comparable scale and complexity.

· Strong stakeholder engagement experience and sound corporate knowledge.

· Previous experience working in or with a complex public-sector organisation.

· Experience supporting voice and telephony transitions and on-premises compute or hypervisor migrations.


Key Responsibilities

· Undertake physical network discovery across client environments, including tracing, identifying, labelling and documenting Ethernet and fibre cabling.

· Plan, execute and test the migration of end-user equipment from the legacy network to the segregated health LAN.

· Use endpoint analysis tools to identify devices, apply appropriate micro-segment tags and analyse traffic profiles.

· Validate firewall rules and access control lists required for communications between micro-segments.

· Develop treatment plans, detailed checklists and test plans using approved templates.

· Coordinate resolution of supporting-service issues involving DNS, DHCP, certificates, group policy and voice services.

· Support Cisco enterprise networks, including Catalyst switching, Layer 2/3 troubleshooting and Cisco SD-Access environments.

· Support live production networks during transition, cutover and hypercare, following runbooks and escalation processes.

· Apply IoT and medical-environment experience to develop treatment plans and coordinate configuration changes with third parties.

· Plan the migration of on-premises compute platforms and hypervisors to the new LAN.

· Document changes, comply with technical change governance, and complete program reporting in the required format and frequency.

OUR PEOPLE:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder - which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

ROLE SUMMARY:

An experienced Senior DevOps engineer is required to join the Technical Services (TTO) team within LSEG Markets & Risk Intelligence. This is a chance to be part of a team and help us build the future of financial services on blockchain technology. The team is responsible for the delivery and support of production environments which are typically housed within Azure, as well as integrating software changes into the enterprise environment as part of ongoing project work. The role includes participation in an on-call rota to ensure coverage during business hours, with plans to expand support coverage as the business scales. Occasional weekend work may be required to support release testing and deployment activities.

DMI (Digital Markets Infrastructure) is an ambitious project: large-scale, complex and uses a range of blockchain architecture patterns, with numerous stakeholders (internal and external) and use cases. The work is focussed on the tokenisation of financial instruments, i.e. as digital assets. We seek candidates with an interest in the financial markets with experience working on large projects. This is a chance to work on an innovative, intellectually challenging project backed by the influential reach of the London Stock Exchange Group.

The ideal candidate will play a vital role in developing, maintaining and enhancing our continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure, supporting application, ensuring high-quality software delivery and uptime.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Implement, manage, and optimize Cloud deployments and automations of DMI applications.
  • Design and manage container orchestration solutions using Kubernetes and similar technologies.
  • Implement, maintain, and optimise containerisation for DMI services (e.g. via Docker).
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and scaling (e.g. Terraform).
  • Integrate security best practices into the DevOps lifecycle, ensuring robustness against vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, QA, and other teams to ensure efficient deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of applications.
  • Keep up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and best practices in DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer science, software engineering, or relevant technical background required.
  • Professional experience in DevOps and infrastructure management.
  • Enterprise experience with Cloud platform Azure (preferably) or AWS.
  • Proficient in Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.
  • Experience with the Azure cloud platform, managing workloads, provisioning & deployments.
  • Deep knowledge of security best practices in cloud and DevOps contexts.
  • Proven knowledge of scaling, availability and cloud resiliency models, patterns and designs.
  • Ability to anticipate potential infrastructure challenges and provide innovative solutions.
  • Interest in new technologies and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with blockchain/DLT desirable.

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

Role Purpose

Genomics runs on multi-trillion-row, petabyte-scale genetic and health data. Mystra is the analytical data platform that makes that usable, and MystraAI is the agentic layer we are building on top of it. This is a Staff-level role that owns the reliability, performance, security and integrity of that infrastructure end-to-end — and sets the technical direction that other teams build on.

You will lead the analytical data platform and our Data-as-a-Service offering, shape the data foundations behind MystraAI, and line-manage a small team of engineers while staying deeply hands-on. If you want your work to sit at the intersection of large-scale infrastructure and genuinely meaningful science, this is it.

A Day in the Life

The role spans the full depth of the platform — from low-level infrastructure reliability and database internals up to the systems that serve data across the product. On any given day you might be:

  • Architecting, tuning and operating multi-tenant ClickHouse or equivalent OLAP database clusters at multi-trillion-row, petabyte scale — sharding and replication, materialised views, merge and query optimisation, tenant isolation and cost/performance trade-offs.

  • Owning SLOs, observability, capacity planning and incident response for data-intensive systems and pipelines, alongside the orchestration and job execution that power them.

  • Shaping Data-as-a-Service as a real product — a secure, multi-tenant, immutable release architecture, with data made discoverable at scale through catalogue and ontology-driven search, in partnership with the data team.

  • Powering agentic AI from the data platform — scaling the data foundations behind MystraAI and owning secure, tenant-scoped access for agents, partnering closely with the ML team on how our AI systems perform.

  • Treating security as a first-class architectural concern — tenant isolation, secrets and credential management, and least-privilege access to systems, tools and data.

  • Setting technical direction, mentoring and line-managing a small team of IC2/IC3 engineers, and influencing decisions well beyond your own team.

Who You Are

You are a recognised specialist who leads through expertise — principal-level individual-contributor depth combined with the judgement to set standards others follow. You will bring:

  • Large-scale OLAP / ClickHouse. Deep experience designing and tuning multi-tenant ClickHouse at extreme scale. You engage with the engine at source level rather than as a black box — and ideally have contributed code upstream.

  • Reliability engineering for data platforms. You bring true SRE discipline — SLOs, observability, capacity planning and incident response — to analytical data systems and pipelines.

  • Data-as-a-Service productisation. You think in terms of data as a product: secure, multi-tenant, immutable releases, and discoverability at scale.

  • Agent-ready data. You understand what it takes to expose platform data to agents safely and at scale — access patterns, tenant isolation, sensible guardrails — and have scaled data infrastructure under demanding workloads.

  • Multi-tenant security. You design for isolation, least-privilege access and sound secrets management from the outset.

  • Technical leadership. You drive direction and innovation across a platform, mentor engineers, and can line-manage a small team without losing your own hands-on edge.

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Salary: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure top-of-market compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., From our London, Oxford Office)

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Genomics politely requests no contact from recruitment agencies. We do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them.

The team consists of six consultants and a manager, partnering with some of Australia’s leading brands across creative, digital and commercial recruitment.

    • Maintain accurate candidate records and activity notes in JobAdder.
    • Keep candidate statuses, availability and contact details current.

  • Performance Expectations

    • The accuracy and quality of screening notes.

  • Able to assess candidate suitability and ask effective screening questions.
  • Commercially aware and capable of understanding different job briefs.
  • Mature, reliable and highly organised.
  • An excellent verbal and written English communicator.
  • Persistent and proactive without being overly aggressive.
  • Comfortable working to activity and placement targets.
  • Able to manage multiple vacancies and candidate pipelines.
  • Experienced with LinkedIn Recruiter, JobAdder or a similar recruitment system.
  • Interested in fashion, retail, beauty, digital, e-commerce and consumer brands.
  • Available to work during Australian business hours.

Benefits

  • A clear placement bonus structure that rewards successful results.
  • The opportunity to develop into a broader candidate management or recruitment role.

title: Project Manager
description:
About IRIS

IRIS Software Group is one of the UK's largest privately held software companies, trusted by 100,000+ businesses, schools and accountancy firms to keep their operations running. Our software pays 1 in 6 UK employees, supports over 12,000 schools, and is relied on by 91 of the top 100 UK accountancy firms.

We're a Great Place to Work® certified employer, recognised for our commitment to well-being, inclusion and development - and we're growing fast.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic Professional Services environment where you will manage complex projects, collaborate with a range of stakeholders, and ensure customers achieve maximum value from their investment.

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading the delivery of software implementation projects from initiation through to completion. Projects may involve multiple products, workstreams, and dependencies, requiring strong leadership, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and key stakeholders.

  • Monitor project performance, budgets, risks, and dependencies.

  • Strong commercial awareness and customer focus.

  • The ability to identify and mitigate project risks effectively.

Desirable

What We Offer

  • Exposure to a diverse customer base and innovative technology solutions.

  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.

  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

Apply today and help shape the success of our customers through exceptional project delivery.

title: Marketing Operations Project Manager for DTC Brand (US-Based, Remote)
description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About Our Client

Dalstrong is one of the most talked-about knife brands of the last decade. We took century-old cutlery houses, combined aggressive design, obsessive product quality, and marketing that actually entertains, and built a roughly $30M direct-to-consumer company around it.

Our knives are sold through Amazon and Dalstrong.com, with a catalog backed by tens of thousands of five-star reviews. Beyond the core brand, we're also growing StudioForge, our licensed collectibles business featuring officially licensed blades from franchises such as DC, The Lord of the Rings, and Game of Thrones.

We're also building a precision knife manufacturing operation in Tampa, launching new American-made blade brands, expanding into retail for the first time, and operating an in-house video studio with a full-time creative production team.

The company is founder-led, fast-moving, and highly focused on AI-enabled marketing and production. Decisions happen in days rather than quarters, and team members own meaningful areas of the business rather than a small slice of one.

Why Leave a Good Job for This?

This is an opportunity to join a company that is actively building and launching—not simply maintaining an existing marketing machine.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across multiple brands and product lines under one roof.
  • Help launch brands coming directly from a new American manufacturing operation.
  • Play a central role in the company's first-ever retail expansion, alongside its established Amazon and DTC channels.
  • Work alongside an in-house video studio with dedicated creative production talent.
  • Operate in a company where AI is already used daily across creative concepting, research, image generation, and production.
  • Own a critical operational function in a small, fast-moving, founder-led team where your work has visible impact.

About the Role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Project Manager to bring structure and accountability to Dalstrong's marketing operation.

You'll own the master marketing calendar, making sure campaigns, launches, product drops, and creative deadlines have clear owners and dates—and that the dates actually mean something.

You'll serve as the connective tissue between marketing, product, and Dalstrong Studios, ensuring that decisions become actionable tasks, creative requests arrive with the information needed to produce them, and launches stay aligned with inventory and product timelines.

What You'll Do

  • Own the single marketing calendar covering campaigns, launches, product drops, and creative deadlines across the marketing group.
  • Coordinate marketing timelines with product availability and inventory.
  • Attend marketing meetings and maintain a commitment log, ensuring every decision has an owner and deadline.
  • Follow up on commitments and escalate missed deadlines when necessary.
  • Act as the bridge between marketing and the in-house video studio, turning incoming requests into clear, production-ready briefs.
  • Coordinate with the product project manager to keep product launches and marketing campaigns on the same timeline.
  • Manage campaign concepts and deliverables through Asana, including the intake queue and shared creative resources.
  • Help improve adoption of Asana across the marketing organization.
  • Publish a weekly miss log showing what slipped, why it slipped, and the new date.
  • Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve marketing workflows and delivery processes.

Requirements

What We're Looking For
