title: Talent Ops Partner
description:
What you'll do...

This is not a traditional recruitment ops role. Talent Ops at Octopus is one of the most important parts of how we protect candidate love, keep our hiring machine moving globally, help our recruiters do brilliant work and make sure our systems, data, reporting and processes are genuinely useful with impact.

Talent Ops is the engine room of Talent. When it works well, candidates feel it, recruiters feel it, hiring managers feel it and the business moves faster and smarter. We’re looking for someone to help improve how we work and help us build a global talent experience that feels fast, smart, human and full of Octopus magic.

This role is perfect for someone who is a recruiter and wants to move into the operational side of talent, or someone who has done talent ops for a few months now and wants to take the next step!

(some of…) What you’ll do

Champion candidate love

As a Talent team, we deal with the highest volume of inbound people reaching out or coming into Octopus after our Customer Ops teams, so response time and care really matter.

Candidate love is one of the most important things we protect. Every interaction tells people who Octopus really is, whether they get the job or not. We want candidates to feel that love and care.

Candidates usually reach us in 4 main ways: They email our Talent inbox, They reach out on social media, They email PR, They reach out directly to leadership.

However they come in, our job is to make sure no candidate disappears into the void. Talent inbox, LinkedIn, social messages and escalations should be actively handled and followed up properly.

Champion candidate love by making sure candidates get fast, kind, clear and human responses throughout the hiring process. You’ll help keep candidate experience visible by tracking response times, ghosting, feedback themes, Lever CX, Glassdoor and escalation trends, making sure issues are resolved properly and learnings are shared so we keep getting better.

Talent Ops should track all of these trends very closely. You will help make sure candidate love is not just something we talk about, but something we measure and improve weekly.

Help improve our talent tech stack

You will help make sure our tools make Talent faster, smarter and more human. That includes Lever, LinkedIn Recruiter, Notion, Slack, Metaview, Glassdoor, job boards, reporting dashboards and any other tools we use across Talent.

You will look at how these tools work together and where they could be simpler, clearer or more useful. Tools are not the strategy. If a tool does not improve speed, quality, insight or candidate love, we should challenge it. If a new tool could have a huge impact, we should test it.

Build strong reporting and insight

Continue to report across all of our Talent tech stack, especially Lever and Lightdash.

You will help build and improve reporting that gives the Head of TA and business a clear view of what is happening, where things are blocked, and where we need to make better decisions. This includes things like, Candidate love and response times, Requisitions and headcount reporting, Lever CX and Glassdoor themes, Source quality (especially our 1.5 million candidates).

The goal is not data theatre. The goal is useful insight that helps us make better hiring decisions, improve the experience and spot problems early! You will work closely with lots of different teams across octopus.

Constantly understand the user experience

You will constantly look at how people experience our hiring process and where we can improve it. That means speaking to people including candidates, watching where things slow down, reviewing feedback daily/weekly, spotting trends and being curious about how the process actually feels in real life.

Improve processes and AI across the workflow

You’ll look at the end to end hiring workflow and help make it better. We want to use AI and tech in a way that helps recruiters spend more time with humans and less time wrestling with admin. AI should help us move faster and improve quality, but it should never make the candidate experience colder, less fair or less Octopus

Keep Lever brilliant

Lever is our live candidate universe. It is not just an ATS. You will help make sure Lever is clean, useful and trusted. If the data is wrong, we need to fix the input, not just explain around it. Good Talent Ops means the team can trust what they see and act quickly. Lever is our core Talent system so we need to build reporting on how effectively Lever is helping us deliver against our needs.

Help the Talent team get better

This role is not just systems and dashboards. It is about helping the whole Talent team work better. You will work closely with our head of talent, recruiters, hiring managers, Talent leaders, Ops, Marketing, Finance and data teams to improve how hiring works across Octopus. You will help educate hiring managers on feedback quality, Lever use, candidate experience and simple hiring processes. You will help recruiters by removing friction, improving tools, creating clearer reporting and making the process easier to run well.

What you'll need...

  • A deep care for candidates and candidate experience

  • Recruitment ops experience, ideally in a fast moving, high volume or global business

  • A brilliant understanding of ATS systems, especially Lever or talent tooling

  • Reporting and data skills. You can turn messy info into useful insight and clear action

  • A continuous improvement mindset. You notice friction, ask why, and make things better

  • A strong eye for detail. Talent Ops is in the detail and the detail really matters.

  • Curiosity about AI, automation and talent technology. You are excited by what tech can do, but you know the human experience comes first.

  • A simple communication style. You can explain complex workflows in a way people actually understand.

  • A “no functional shoulder pads” mindset. It is not your team versus another team. It is all of us working together to change the energy system globally.

  • You get stuck in, make progress and do not wait for perfect.

  • A belief that simplicity beats complexity. If something is too hard to teach or explain clearly, it is probably too complex.

  • A real care for the Octopus way of doing things: fast, human, kind and never corporate sludge

Why else you'll love it here
• Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!• Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership• Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.
P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at [email protected] and we’d love to help!
Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at [email protected]. We’re happy to help!

Description

Senior Quantexa Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Quantexa Developer with strong technical expertise and leadership capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering end-to-end Quantexa solutions, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality outcomes aligned with business objectives.

Quantexa Development & Delivery

Requirements Analysis & CDE Definition

  • Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications within the Quantexa framework

Entity Resolution & Scoring Optimization

  • Develop, test, and optimize entity resolution models and scoring methodologies
  • Validate and fine-tune models to enhance detection accuracy and system efficiency

Simulation & Threshold Calibration

Stakeholder Management

Team Leadership

title: Product Designer
description:
Some key info for you about Liberis:

🌱 We were founded in 2007

💰 We have provided over $3bn of funding to small businesses so far

🚀 We have been named in CNBC & Statista Top 150 UK Fintechs for 2025

🌍 We're a global team, with a dynamic presence in 6 key locations around the world

🧠 We're a thriving community of over 290 innovative minds

👩🏾 🤝 👨🏼 We're a vibrant melting pot, celebrating over 27 nationalities in our team

🏢 Our team brings experience from over 740 previous companies, from startups to global giants

🎯 We have just been named as one of FinTech’s Finest 50 by Welcome to the Jungle

💪 We’re proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!

Our Product & Engineering Team:

Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data & Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.

Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.

The team

You’ll join Liberis’ Product Design team, working alongside product managers, engineers, and researchers across the business to help shape exceptional financial experiences to support small business!

The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help evolve the internal systems our teams rely on and the service journeys that connect them to our merchants and partners. You’ll take ownership of design problems from discovery through to shipped, polished interfaces, partnering closely with product managers and engineers along the way!

This is a hands-on role focused primarily on design delivery within our fulfilment area. You’ll work on complex workflows and internal systems used by teams including Operations, Underwriting and Collections, turning an established product vision into well-considered features that can be shipped in manageable increments. Success in this role looks like well-crafted, research informed interfaces that ship on time!

You’ll join a collaborative environment with engaged users and a strong front-end engineering team. Because the people using your work are close to the product team, you’ll have regular opportunities to understand their needs, test ideas and see the immediate impact of what you deliver.

What you’ll get to do in the role:

At Liberis, our internal systems are at the core of how we support small businesses. In this role, you'll design and ship the interfaces our operational teams rely on every day, turning complex workflows into clear, usable tools.

You'll partner closely with your Product Manager and Engineering Manager throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and early concepts through to delivery and post-launch iteration, shaping decisions together rather than handing off a finished design.

You'll build and iterate on high-fidelity UI in Figma, taking designs from early wireframes through to pixel-perfect, developer-ready screens, and take ownership of our design system, keeping components and patterns consistent across the product.

You'll work directly with the operational teams who use these systems day to day, running interviews and usability testing to understand where the friction is, and mapping their end-to-end journeys to find where processes break down and spot opportunities to fix them.

What we think you’ll need:

  • You’re comfortable facilitating UX research and communicating findings clearly to validate your decisions for new product features.
  • You think strategically about the long-term implications of design decisions and are used to planning well beyond the feature immediately required to ensure products continue to evolve with clear direction.
  • Strong Figma experience is essential for this role, including knowledge of component best practice, auto layout and variant management. Experience using developer handover features would also be highly beneficial.
  • Your design process is highly collaborative; you iterate openly and validate quickly with feedback from stakeholders and design peers before aligning on a path forward.
  • You are comfortable working alongside engineers to turn designs into shipped product features, with an awareness of feasibility and technical dependencies. You judge your work by what’s shipped, not what’s in your design file.
  • Ability to prototype at pace with a high level of interactivity and attention to detail to bring designs to life for stakeholders and users.
  • Experience running usability testing and validating that products meet user expectations and adhere to WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Knowledge of service design strategies including service blueprints, user journey maps and identifying opportunities across multi-channel processes.

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com

title: Deputy Company Secretary, ASX Group
description:
ASX: Powering Australia's financial markets

Why join the ASX?

When you join ASX, you’re joining a company with a strong purpose – to power a stronger economic future by enabling a fair and dynamic marketplace for all.

In your new role, you’ll be part of a leading global securities exchange with a strong brand. We are known for being a trusted market operator and an exciting data hub.

Want to know why we are a great place to work, click on the link to learn more.

www.asx.com.au/about/careers/a-great-place-to-work

We are more than a securities exchange!

The ASX team brings together talented people from a diverse range of disciplines.

We run critical market infrastructure, with 1 in 3 people employed within technology. Yet we have a unique complexity of roles across a range of disciplines such as operations, program delivery, financial products, investor engagement, risk and compliance.

We’re proud to foster a workplace where diversity is celebrated and inclusion is part of our everyday culture. Our employee-led networks champion LGBTIQ+ inclusion, promote gender equality, accessibility and wellbeing, inspire giving and volunteering, and celebrate cultural and religious events, creating a sense of belonging for all. As an AWEI Bronze employer and member of the Champions of Change Coalition for gender equality, we’re committed to a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

About the team:

An opportunity for an experienced company secretary to join a top-talent, dynamic and diverse team at the centre of Australia’s financial markets.

The ASX Group Company Secretariat function supports effective governance for ASX Group’s legal entities (other than the Clearing and Settlement entities) by delivering high-quality Board services, maintaining governance processes, supporting compliance with statutory, regulatory and licence obligations, and enabling clear, timely and effective engagement between directors, management and regulators.

What you will be doing:

  • Bring your strong passion for corporate governance to a leading in-house team working at the centre of listed company regulation and governance

  • Deliver high-quality and leading-edge governance practices

  • Use your strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills to help ASX deliver high-quality Board meetings, papers and other services

  • Work collaboratively with cross functional teams, interact directly with Boards and Senior Management across ASX Group and produce high-quality communications

  • Share your knowledge, skills and experience to lift capabilities across the company secretariat team and the broader business

  • Continue to develop as a company secretary in an engaging and challenging environment

  • Develop peer external and internal contacts

Achievement of strong governance outcomes

  • Contributing to the development of a strong and diverse corporate governance practice, including continuous disclosure and other Listing Rules issues, directors’ duties, conflicts management, executive accountability and remuneration

  • Ensuring strong processes are in place and operating effectively to ensure full compliance by ASX with its listing rule and statutory obligations

  • Supporting the Head of Company Secretariat, ASX Group to service ASX’s Boards and Committees capably and proactively, including meetings, workshops, director education programs, and related documentation and communications

  • Providing company secretarial support to committees, from agenda planning to minute taking and everything in between

  • Working effectively with all business functions on Board papers and presentations and other collaborative processes

  • Timely and effective regulatory reporting and engagement across the range of ASX’s statutory obligations and other requirements

Collaborating with colleagues and effective stakeholder engagement

  • Collaborating with internal colleagues to improve and maintain the quality of Board papers and other materials

  • Reviewing Board and committee papers to support executives and management in providing high quality material for directors

  • Developing and providing training on preparing board papers

  • Helping to ensure strong communication between management and Boards to support a “no surprises” approach

  • Liaising with investors, regulators, professional and industry bodies and others to support on-going constructive two-way relationships

  • Developing corporate governance resources and bringing new ideas and experiences to ASX’s Company Secretariat team

What you will bring:

Must have

  • Built your skills and reputation in a challenging in-house role

  • Practiced in corporate governance, developing a thorough knowledge of the Corporations Act and a good practical understanding of corporate governance and the ASX Listing Rules

  • 5 or more years experience with a proven ability to work independently

  • Strong academic and professional qualifications

  • Won the respect and recognition of your peers for integrity and governance excellence

  • Confidence and capability to work independently, with the judgement to communicate and escalate where needed

  • Strong ethics and ability to establish a high level of trust

  • Ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with directors, senior management and staff members

  • Ability to develop strong internal and external networks

  • Attention to detail and factual accuracy

  • Understanding and enjoyment of the contribution and potential of the role

  • Personal commitment to growth

  • A “team player” attitude: prepared to pitch in to help others and share your knowledge and experience

  • A collaborative and collegiate style, and strong presentational and influencing skills

Nice to have

  • Experience in regulated Australian listed companies with a strong reputation for governance and compliance

  • A demonstrated commitment to best practice corporate governance through education, industry involvement or otherwise

  • Experience in financial services or another highly-regulated industry

  • Dealing with regulators in Australia or overseas

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities and experience, and how you’ll help us to live our values. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the criteria of this role.

If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process to help you present your best self, please let us know at careers@asx.com.au.

At ASX Group, our diverse workforce is essential to build and maintain a fair and dynamic marketplace. We support flexible working and offer hybrid working options. Even if our roles are advertised as full-time, we encourage you to apply if you are interested in part-time or other flexible working arrangements.

We will arrange for successful candidates to have background checks, including reference and police checks, completed as part of the on-boarding process.

To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorised to work in Australia on a permanent basis without any restrictions.

title: Data Architect - AI | Outside IR35 | Remote
description:
Data Architect - AI Governance | Outside IR35 | Remote


We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to support a public sector organisation in defining its enterprise-level AI data principles and associated governance controls. This is an initial two-month engagement, with potential for extension.


The Role
Working at SFIA Level 5, you will review existing data architecture and AI governance materials before developing a clear set of principles addressing the risks associated with the use of data in AI. You will work across data, security, privacy and governance teams to ensure the principles are practical, comprehensive and aligned with the wider enterprise architecture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing data design, architecture and agentic AI principles.
  • Identify gaps relating to AI data quality, privacy, security, provenance, lineage and bias.
  • Define enterprise AI data principles aligned with the organisation's wider architecture and governance strategy.
  • Facilitate workshops and build agreement across data, security, privacy, risk, compliance and AI governance teams.
  • Translate agreed principles into practical policies, processes and governance controls.
  • Create, update and map AI controls to support consistent adoption and assurance.


Essential

  • Senior Data Architect operating at SFIA Level 5.
  • Strong enterprise data architecture and data governance experience.
  • Proven background defining data principles, standards and governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting AI, generative AI or responsible AI governance initiatives.
  • Good understanding of AI-specific data risks, including quality, privacy, security, provenance, lineage, bias and accountability.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation and consensus-building skills.
  • Experience translating architectural principles into actionable controls, policies and processes.


Desirable

  • Familiarity with DAMA and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Knowledge of ISO 42001, ISO 27001 and UK GDPR.
  • Experience delivering within public sector or similarly regulated environments.
  • Understanding of agentic AI governance and associated data considerations.


The Details

  • Contract role: Initial 2 months, with potential extension
  • IR35 Status: Outside IR35
  • Rate:£500 - £525
  • Location: Remote
  • Start date: ASAP


If you are a senior Data Architect with strong AI governance and enterprise data principles experience, please apply to discuss the engagement further.

Ready to impact a better future?

You’ll lead and support investigations, provide expert security advice, and help ensure the highest standards of compliance and integrity across the contract.

This is a role with real purpose. Your work will help maintain safe and secure custody environments, strengthen trust in critical public services, and support a positive security culture that has a direct impact on colleagues, service users, and communities. By identifying risks, supporting continuous improvement, and driving high standards, you'll help create impactful solutions that contribute to a safer future.

What you’ll do as an Investigations and Security Officer

You’ll be entrusted to:

  • Conduct investigations into operational incidents and security matters in line with relevant procedures, policies, and legislation.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance to operational managers on investigation methodologies, security matters, and best practice.
  • Gather, analyse, and assess intelligence to support informed decision-making and risk reduction activities.

Does this sound like you?

  • A formal investigation qualification, or you are working towards a recognised investigation-related qualification.
  • Experience conducting investigations within a custodial, criminal justice, law enforcement, or similar regulated environment.
  • A strong understanding of investigative principles, evidence handling, and risk and threat reduction practices.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and report-writing skills, with the ability to assess complex issues and recommend appropriate actions.
  • A full UK driving licence and the flexibility to travel extensively and stay away from home when required and sometimes at short notice for a number of days.

Vetting and checks

You will also complete an Occupational Health Questionnaire to allow us to provide any support needed for you to succeed in the role.

Discover all you need to keep growing

  • Employee networks: Our networks support inclusion and connection by providing spaces for collaboration, learning, and belonging. They represent and empower all our colleagues including LGBTQIA+ employees, women, parents and carers, people with disabilities, veterans, and people from all cultural backgrounds.

Let’s impact a better future, together. Apply today.

This role is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974.

At Serco, everyone plays a vital part in delivering essential public services that make a real difference. As a global team of 50,000 people across Defence, Transport, Justice, Immigration, Healthcare, Leisure and Citizen Services, we’re united by a shared purpose: to improve the services that communities rely on. Guided by our values of Trust, Care, Innovation and Pride, our people make meaningful impact, every single day.

title: Senior Staff Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role:

We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer for Origination & New Products.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. You'll lead the Origination & New Products squad through ambiguous, no-precedent build work - deep Rosso integration, pricing capability, and deal-gating risk tooling. You won't own hiring, performance, or comp for anyone in the squad; you'll lead through technical direction, judgement, and execution.

Your squad is where you'll do the work, but it's not where your impact stops. You're accountable for outcomes that reach across the Sell team - other squads working against the same origination targets, the Engineering Manager's roadmap, and the broader engineering culture at tem. Success here looks like other squads building faster because of patterns and standards you set, not just your own squad shipping on time.

Beyond the squad, you'll be a strategic partner to the Engineering Manager, turning company-level targets into engineering outcomes - starting with growing origination volume through new products over the first 12 months, and later supporting the team as Sell Side expands internationally.

You'll lead a new three person squad to help you deliver your goals.

You will:

  • Own the delivery for new product categories

  • Lead technically through execution - design, build, and ship alongside the squad, not just direct it.

  • Translate ambiguous, commercially-driven problems into a shape the squad can deliver against.

  • Partner with commercial and product stakeholders to keep new-product work tied to real pipeline outcomes.

  • Mentor the squad's engineers and raise technical standards, without owning their performance or career progression.

  • Set technical direction and standards that other squads in Sell adopt - your influence is measured beyond your own team's delivery.

You will report into the Engineering Manager, Sell Side.

Responsibilities:

Lead through execution

  • Drive the Origination & New Products squad's technical direction on deep integrations with other internal services

  • Stay hands-on: design, build, and review the hardest parts of the new-product build sequence yourself.

  • Take a company target ("grow origination volume through new products") and break it into a sequenced, deliverable plan without needing to be told how.

Build for ambiguity and risk

  • Design systems for categories that don't exist yet at tem - Unlocking TWh’s of new pipeline - where the spec is being written as you go.

  • Make judgement calls on commercial risk in deal-gating tooling, not just deliver what's asked.

  • Prevent domain drift as new product categories are added, keeping shared language and clear boundaries.

Partner beyond the squad

  • Work directly with the Engineering Manager and commercial stakeholders to keep new-product delivery tied to origination pipeline outcomes, not just shipped features.

  • Be a reference point for other squads across Sell facing similar Rosso integration, pricing, or risk-tooling problems - your judgement should raise the bar beyond your own team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards and practice that outlast this squad - patterns, conventions, and technical decisions other engineers in Sell (and beyond) will build on.

  • As Sell Side expands internationally, represent the technical view in conversations with new-market stakeholders and partners.

  • Mentor engineers in the squad and raise engineering standards, while staying on the individual-contributor track.

Requirements:

Must haves

  • Proven technical leadership at Staff or Senior Staff level, with evidence of leading complex, ambiguous initiatives to real business impact - not just technical execution in isolation.

  • Comfort operating without a spec: able to take a broad, undefined opportunity and shape it into something buildable.

  • Sound commercial judgement - able to reason about deal risk and revenue impact, not just delivery.

  • Deep enough platform fluency to integrate against a complex, business-critical system

  • Track record leading a squad or team technically through direction and mentorship, without necessarily holding formal people-management responsibility.

  • Evidence of influence beyond your immediate team - raising technical standards, unblocking other teams, or shaping practice that other engineers adopted.

  • Strong written and verbal communication - comfortable being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and, over time, external partners.

  • Comfortable in our core stack: Python, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge), and event-driven architectures - the same stack Rosso and the rest of Sell Side build on.

Bonus points

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain.

  • Experience taking a product or company into a new international market.

  • Exposure to workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, or real-time pricing engines.

  • Experience originating new product lines from scratch rather than only scaling existing ones.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £117,850 or equivalent in local currency.

    • We review salaries twice a year using real-time market data, with transparent, consistent pay for the same role and level.

  • Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday .

  • Remote & flexible working - We’re fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behaviour Interview with our Engineering Managers (60 Mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss technical topics and experiences.

  4. Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: BI Developer
description:
INEOS Automotive - Built For More

Story so far

Since we started our journey to build a no nonsense 4X4, we've come a long way. We've established INEOS Automotive as a serious contender in 4X4 development and manufacturing. We've partnered with some of the biggest names in the automotive industry. We've made our way from vision to prototype. We've secured a world-class production facility and delivery team. We've delivered Grenadiers to customers all around the world. We're building our double cab pick up, the Quartermaster.

People and Culture

Easy never changed anything. Not in manufacturing, science, engineering or energy - and certainly not elite sport. At INEOS we tackle every challenge head-on, and we help extraordinary athletes achieve extraordinary things. When it comes to making positive change, we know nothing gets done without grit, rigor and humor. Our Automotive team consist of around 1500 employees, 10 locations and 44 nationalities, we're an international team working together to challenge the ordinary.

If this sounds like you, let's talk.

Your role:

We are looking for a BI Developer to join Global Sales Operations, working alongside the Global Sales Reporting Lead to build and maintain the reporting estate that supports INEOS Automotive's global sales, retailer and customer experience operations.

This is a hands-on delivery role. Requirements, stakeholder decisions and go-live approvals are owned by the Reporting Lead; your focus is turning agreed requirements into robust, well-modelled Power BI solutions on top of our Snowflake data platform. You will work across a live portfolio of dashboards spanning leads, order take, handovers, retailer performance, inventory and customer experience.

Our stack is Microsoft Power BI (including composite models over Azure Analysis Services and shared enterprise datasets), Snowflake as the data warehouse, and Power Automate for reporting workflow automation.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading company. Our commitment to extending data and reporting products and services across the company provides great scope and opportunity to significantly develop and grow your career.

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Scoping, designing, building, servicing, and supporting all new and existing reports / dashboards within the organisation with the goal of providing robust analytical solutions that support the strategic aims
  • Gathering, inspecting, cleaning, transforming and modelling data with the goal of discovering useful information, suggesting conclusions, and supporting decision-making
  • Capturing data requirements to design, extend or maintain, logical and physical data models which support new and existing BI initiatives
  • Delivering testing, maintaining test scenarios, user acceptance testing and end user training
  • Responsible for the BI estate and conducting approved technology upgrades, providing technical advice, product information and 1st line support for the BI user community

What we are looking for:

  • Strong, demonstrable Power BI development skill: data modelling, advanced DAX (filter context, time intelligence, performance), Power Query, and report design
  • Experience with composite models and shared/enterprise datasets (DirectQuery to Analysis Services or Power BI datasets), including their limitations around relationships and calculated columns
  • Strong SQL, with the ability to write, test and tune queries and views against a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred)
  • Solid grasp of dimensional modelling (Kimball) and when to solve a problem in the warehouse versus the semantic model
  • Experience administering the Power BI Platform: licensing, security roles and permissions, and workspaces
  • Ability to work from written requirements independently, flag risks early, and respect approval gates on structural model changes
  • Fluent in English, with good verbal and non-verbal communication skills

Desired Experience:

  • Experience in report / dashboard development using PowerBI
  • Experience in managing the PowerBI Platform (licencing, security, workspaces)
  • Exposure to SAP-sourced data (S/4HANA, C4C) and ELT tools such as Dell Boomi
  • Power Automate (or similar) for scheduled data exports and workflow automation
  • Experience in coding with SQL and manipulating large datasets
  • Experience in building data pipelines (extract, transform and load) to transport a wide variety of data types and high volumes of data
  • Experience of developing end to end data solutions using the Microsoft stack namely, Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with data platforms such as Snowflake
  • Experience in requirement gathering and report/dashboard design
  • Experience in time and project management using Agile or Waterfall principals
  • Experience in training, presenting, and communicating technical topics to a non-technical audience at all levels
  • Knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts and best practice - architecture and methodology (ideally Kimball) and BI Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

Behavioural skills:

  • Pro-activity - the drive to actively own the products both in development and in operation
  • Communication - explain to the goals, objectives, and limitations of product design
  • Positivity - see the opportunities in situations; ensure the team understands the benefit of the work
  • Detail - question solutions and situations to ensure the business & team understand positions taken
  • Commerciality - understand the business reason for the work beyond the technical challenges

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Want to deliver tech with purpose, with people who care?

Join us in our mission to create solutions that help keep children safe online.


Who are we?

Headquartered in Perth, Australia, with offices around the world, Qoria is an ASX-listed global leader in child digital safety technology and services. We are a purpose-driven business operating under the Linewize brand in North America and Asia Pacific, the Smoothwall brand in the UK, the Qustodio brand in EMEA, and Qoria LK in Sri Lanka.

Our solutions are used by schools, school districts, and parental communities to protect children from harmful online content, identify students at risk based on their digital behaviours, and help teachers maintain focus and safe learning environments in the digital classroom. Today, 30,000 schools and 7 million parents rely on our solutions to help keep 25 million children safe across 180 countries worldwide.

What’s the opportunity ?

The Senior Data Analyst owns the analysis of large and complex data sets. They rely on deep knowledge of the company’s data models and products and proficiency with big data platforms. Senior Analysts provide insight - not just data - to their technical peers, product managers and engineering leaders. They own the privacy, security, quality and content of the data products they create and manage on the data platform.

Here’s how you’ll do it:

Product Alignment: The Senior Data Analyst translates product objectives into actionable data analysis, collaborating closely with engineers and senior stakeholders to ensure that data insights drive successful project outcomes and high quality products. They understand the broader business context to help set data-driven roadmaps that advance the company’s prospects through clear communication and influential storytelling.

Data Product Ownership: Responsible for the end-to-end analysis of large and complex data sets, the Senior Data Analyst delivers reliable, high-quality insights and data products. They leverage deep knowledge of company products, data models and data platforms - applying rigorous quality tests and utilising automation platforms to ensure the resilience and accuracy of all analytical outputs.

Analytical Excellence and Mentorship: As a domain expert, the Senior Data Analyst sets the standards for data quality and analytical rigor across the organisation. They influence teams to improve data practices and use mentorship to grow data literacy and technical capabilities, imparting industry knowledge to help peers and stakeholders make more informed, data-driven decisions.

  • Advanced data analysis and insight generation from large, complex data sets.

  • Proficiency with big data platforms and deep knowledge of query execution and costs, data models and reporting packages.

  • Strong technical skills to build, deploy, and maintain data products, utilising our automation platforms..

  • Analytical leadership, including setting standards for data quality and rigor across the organization.

  • Exceptional communication and influential storytelling abilities to present insights to senior stakeholders, peers, and product managers.

  • Experience in mentorship and growing data literacy and technical capabilities within teams.

  • Commitment to data ownership, including privacy, security, quality, and content of data products.

Why choose Qoria:

In this role, you can expect:

  • Employee stock options.

  • Enhanced holiday & family leave.

  • Tech Allowance

  • and much more.

More importantly, you’ll:

  • Deliver tech with purpose…

As part of our Engineering team, your work truly matters. Your creativity, organisational skills and understanding of our tech customers’/clients’ needs will help grow and nurture our membership. This means helping more children stay safe online.

  • With people who care...

You’ll work among a tight-knit team of professionals who share your passion for enabling safe online environments. We all take ownership of our work, end to end. And at the same time, we really care about growing and winning together.

  • Through work that you love...

Being a Senior

Data Analyst takes skill, energy and resilience. It can also be incredibly rewarding. Here, your efforts will be visible and you’ll love the impact you have.

  • And a career that you own.

A proven career path forward, with real opportunities to progress your career into other teams and departments within the company. Regular company wide lunch and learn sessions.

We’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

The Oklahoma Department of Agriculture, Food and Forestry (ODAFF) is seeking a full-time Meat Inspector in the Food Safety Division. This position (PIN #04000333) is in state government and will be required to work throughout Oklahoma with primary counties being Marshall and Murray.

The State of Oklahoma offers a comprehensive Benefits Package, including a generous benefit allowance to offset the cost of insurance premiums for employees and their eligible dependents.

The hourly pay for this position is up to $25.07 based on education and experience.

Basic Purpose/Position Description: This position is responsible for performing inspections at meat and poultry plants in Oklahoma to ensure compliance with applicable federal and state laws, rules and regulations.

Typical Functions:

  • Quickly identify abnormalities in food animals prior to and after slaughter
  • Recognize and identify actual and potential food safety hazards in the meat-processing environment
  • Perform agriculture inspections at meat processing establishments
  • Complete and submit reports and documents
  • Collect, package and ship samples

Level Descriptor: This is the basic level of this job family where employees are assigned responsibilities, which primarily involve inspecting, sampling and investigating facilities or individuals regulated by the Food Safety Division.

Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities: Requirements at this level include knowledge of procedures for inspecting, evaluating and grading various agricultural commodities; of state and USDA regulations governing the standards and transport of applicable agricultural products; of federal and state laws regarding packaging, labeling and other standards related to agricultural products; of environmental and sanitation standards; of materials and equipment used in the applicable agricultural industry; of various types of animal and plant diseases; of record keeping; of basic mathematics including percentages; and of English usage.

Ability is required to conduct inspections related to agricultural products, services, and facilities to determine compliance with established standards, laws and regulations; to follow complex oral and written instructions; to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others; to attend to several matters simultaneously; to operate and maintain monitoring and detection equipment; and to apply research methodologies.

Education and Experience: Requirements at this level consist of a bachelor’s degree in an agricultural, biological, plant, animal, physical or natural science, food technology, or a closely related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience; or the completion of a two-year meat science program.

Physical Demands and Work Environment: This position may require travel to multiple locations within Oklahoma on a daily basis; working conditions may be in extremely hot or cold environments while working in areas that require handling sharp tools and equipment.

Additional Information:

Applicants must possess a valid driver’s license to fulfill all job-related travel including some overnight travel for out-of-state meetings. Applicant is expected to conduct themselves in a professional manner that represents the State of Oklahoma at all times.

This position is subject to a twelve-month probationary period.

Reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities may be provided upon request.

title: Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales Account Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.

Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.

The role entails

  • Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Junior redovisningskonsult till Aspia - Malmö, Lund, Helsingborg
description:
Har du studerat ekonomi på universitet eller högskola och vill börja arbeta som redovisningskonsult? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig! Vi söker just nu juniora redovisningskonsulter till vårt kontor i Malmö, Lund eller Helsingborg, där du blir en del av ett härligt gäng kollegor i ett bolag som värnar om balansen mellan arbete och privatliv. Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden samtidigt som du får en varierande och utvecklande roll där du får möjlighet att arbeta med kunder i olika branscher. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt uppdrag:

Att arbeta som redovisningskonsult hos oss på Aspia innebär att du får du vara med och utveckla våra kunders företagande, samtidigt som du själv utvecklas och utmanas tillsammans med dina kollegor i vardagen. I rollen som junior redovisningskonsult på Aspia har du ett omväxlande och självständigt arbete, där du arbetar på olika uppdrag åt våra kunder.

Vi arbetar alltid i team i våra uppdrag och du kommer därmed ha ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor. Tillsammans ser vi till att ge en högkvalitativ leverans till kund samt ger input och feedback till varandra utifrån respektive roll. Arbetet sker primärt på vårt eget kontor men kan också komma att ske ute hos kund.

Som junior redovisningskonsult, kommer dina arbetsuppgifter främst att bestå av:

  • Löpande bokföring
  • Upprättande av månadsbokslut
  • Månatliga avstämningar
  • Rapportering till kund

Hos oss får du lära dig redovisningsyrket från grunden. Vi utmanar dig, stöttar dig och tror på dig!

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

  • Studerar/har studerat ekonomi på universitet, högskola eller yrkeshögskola och kommer ta din examen senast januari 2027.
  • Vi ser gärna att du vid examen uppfyller de teoretiska kunskapskraven för att bli auktoriserad redovisningskonsult (för information, läs mer på far.se).
  • Vidare ser vi även att du behärskar svenska obehindrat i tal och skrift, samt har goda kunskaper i engelska.

För att du ska trivas och utvecklas i rollen som redovisningskonsult hos oss tror vi att du är en driven person som trivs i en relationsbyggande roll där kundvård, rådgivning och service är i fokus. Du trivs i mötet med kunden, har lätt för att etablera förtroendefulla kontakter och besitter en god kommunikativ förmåga.

Då vi arbetar i team tror vi att det är bra om du tycker om att arbeta nära dina kollegor, samt har förmågan att samarbeta med andra. Vidare ser vi även att du har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya situationer samt har förmågan att arbeta parallellt med flera uppgifter.

Du erbjuds!

Vårt mål på Aspia är att ge dig som medarbetare den bästa tiden i din karriär och vi är måna om balansen mellan privatliv och arbete. Hos oss får du ett arbete med frihet under ansvar och flexibel arbetstid, kollektivavtal och bra förmåner. Vi tycker att det är viktigt att du känner dig stimulerad i din roll och arbetar därför strukturerat med medarbetarsamtal där du sätter mål och planer för din utveckling. Sist, men inte minst, får du ett härligt gäng kollegor med bred kompetens i ett socialt arbetsklimat!

Praktiskt om tjänsten:

  • Tjänsten är på heltid med tillträdesdatum i Januari 2027. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
  • Placeringsort: Malmö, Lund eller Helsingborg.

Låter det som en intressant tjänst för dig? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

Du ansöker enkelt genom att skicka in ditt CV och besvara våra urvalsfrågor direkt i vårt verktyg. Med hänsyn av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl.

Om du går vidare till nästa steg hos oss, kommer du att få en inbjudan till att genomföra två arbetspsykologiska tester. Testerna mäter logisk förmåga samt personliga egenskaper.

Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat genom hela vår rekryteringsprocess och gör en objektiv och samlad bedömning av din kompetens, erfarenhet och potential att växa i rollen.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: COLE200: Student Groups Team Lead
description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

This is a pro-bono position.

JerseySTEM is looking for talented professionals across our departments to commit time and energy as long-term engagement for our mission to provide STEM education to underrepresented middle school girls.

The College Engagement Student Groups Team Lead organizes the outreach, engagement and interaction with the Student Groups on campus in order to secure access/exposure to their membership and ultimately recruit them as program instructors.

Those student groups are of 3 types: Professional (ACM, ASCE, IEEE,..) , Affinity (SHE, SWE, SHPE, WICYS),... or Greek life.

JerseySTEM focuses on 30 Universities in NJ, 10 students org within each university and the 4-5 Board members of each student group.

Responsibilities

  • Work with COLE Department head to define the strategy and targets for the incoming school year
  • Research colleges and their student groups, identify student group chapters and their leadership, locate their contacts and maintain that information in Salesforce.
  • Engage with, Establish and maintain relationships with Student organizations in each campus by securing meeting time and securing presentations
  • Coordinate Marketing Material with Marketing Departments
  • Execute Recruitment campaigns and enlist student organizations to relay our message to their members
  • Mandatory meetings:
    • Attend virtual Department meetings weekly : (Sundays 5pm EST)
    • Monthly Leadership Meeting

Qualifications

  • Genuine concern about/interest in solving the STEM education gender gap
  • Ability to establish and maintain connections with area schools
  • Resourceful, can-do attitude
  • Experience with K-12 schools as a parent, former student professionally
  • Outreach experience preferred-
  • Experience with community outreach, relationship development, Not shy on phone or email.
  • Comfort working in a ‘virtual organization’ with digital tools (G-Suite, Slack, Jira, salesforce)
  • Would be a plus if candidate has flexible schedule to allow for day time calls with the school admins during the work week

Time Commitment

  • 3-6 Hours weekly
  • 6 months minimum

title: Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure
description:
Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement enterprise-grade Azure cloud architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, identity, and data services, with explicit attention to scalability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code through version control and peer review.
  • Configure and manage Azure landing zones, virtual networks, subnets, route tables, and network security groups to enforce strong segmentation and least-privilege connectivity between workloads.
  • Implement secure identity, access management, and governance controls using Azure Active Directory, conditional access, role-based access control, and Azure Policy to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
  • Architect and operate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pool design, auto-scaling, network policy, and integration with container registries and service meshes.
  • Deploy, scale, and tune Azure data and analytics platforms such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, and Event Hubs to meet specific workload patterns and SLAs.
  • Build and operate comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling fast, automated, and auditable releases of both infrastructure and application code.
  • Design and implement robust observability practices using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and third-party tooling, with thoughtful dashboards, alerting, and SLO tracking.
  • Drive Azure cost optimization initiatives, including right-sizing, reserved-instance planning, lifecycle policies, and architectural changes that meaningfully reduce monthly cloud spend.
  • Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity strategies, including backup, geo-replication, failover testing, and documented runbooks that have been validated through regular drills.
  • Strengthen security posture by integrating Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, key vault, and managed identities, and by routinely remediating findings from compliance scans.
  • Collaborate closely with application teams to architect cloud-native solutions, advising on patterns, anti-patterns, and Azure-native services that best fit each problem domain.
  • Develop automation scripts and tooling in PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline repetitive operational work and reduce time-to-resolution for common incidents.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture reviews, and contribute actively to internal communities of practice around Azure and DevOps.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
  • Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.
  • Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

title: Target2 Process Owner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Target2 Process Owner based in Switzerland.

This is a senior, hands-on payment operations role responsible for establishing and owning the operational model for direct TARGET2 participation.
You will lead the transition from indirect participation to a fully controlled direct operating environment, covering processes, infrastructure, controls, and contingency planning.
The role spans the complete lifecycle from process design and UAT through BIC-by-BIC migration and stable business-as-usual operations.
You will work at the intersection of Payment Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Risk, and external financial infrastructure partners.
A major part of the role involves direct coordination with regulatory and scheme stakeholders, including central banking and payment infrastructure organizations.
You will play a critical role in protecting payment continuity, customer experience, regulatory readiness, and operational resilience.
This opportunity is ideal for an experienced payments professional who combines strong operational judgment with deep knowledge of SEPA, TARGET Services, and payment infrastructure.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end operational setup for direct TARGET2 participation, including process design, documentation, testing, migration, go-live readiness, and ongoing business-as-usual operations.
  • Establish and maintain payment operations processes covering SCT and SCT Inst recalls, payment inquiries and investigations, pacs.028 status requests, rejects, returns, refunds, and exception handling.
  • Own incoming and outgoing SWIFT enquiry processes, including MT199 and MT999 messages, RFIs, and relevant ISO 20022 messaging flows such as pacs, camt, and pain.
  • Define and operate processes for incoming RTGS payments, including payment monitoring, unmatched or pending items, exception handling, returns, Escrow arrangements, and confirmation of payment receipt.
  • Operate and maintain the T2 GUI and related U2A/A2A capabilities as a senior authorized user for payment tracking, returns, liquidity visibility, and manual or fallback actions.
  • Maintain TARGET operational infrastructure, including CRDM reference data, BICs, routing, accounts, users, roles, certificates, four-eyes authorization matrices, and production segregation of duties.
  • Lead the dual-route transition from indirect to direct participation, ensuring payments remain routable and traceable by BIC and payment path while defining criteria for retiring legacy dependencies.
  • Own the Payment Operations interface with daily reconciliation across MCA, RTGS DCA, and TIPS DCA, escalating liquidity-related issues that could affect payment execution or customer outcomes.
  • Redesign incident management and escalation procedures for direct participation, including operational detection, payment-impact assessment, DNB notifications, reporting, and evidence retention.
  • Define and maintain Payment Operations procedures for severe TARGET disruptions and the Eurosystem contingency solution, including training and testing evidence.
  • Coordinate directly with scheme and infrastructure stakeholders, central banking authorities, SWIFT/NSP providers, service providers, correspondent banks, and other financial institutions.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to test interfaces, identify operational and back-office requirements, and determine which processes should remain automated versus manual.
  • Ensure every critical payment process has a clearly assigned owner, documented procedures, defined controls, escalation paths, fallback mechanisms, and successful UAT evidence.
  • Drive a successful migration with no material customer impact and establish stable post-go-live operations without residual dependence on external sponsor-bank operational processes.

    • Requirements:

    • Minimum 3+ years of experience in payment operations within a bank, Electronic Money Institution (EMI), Payment Service Provider (PSP), or similar financial services environment.
    • Hands-on experience with SEPA payment schemes, particularly SCT and SCT Inst, and TARGET Services such as T2/RTGS and TIPS.
    • Strong practical knowledge of payment investigations, recalls, returns, refunds, and exception-management workflows.
    • Working knowledge of SWIFT and ISO 20022 messaging standards, including MT199, MT999, pacs, camt, and pain messages.
    • Experience operating financial infrastructure interfaces and tools directly, ideally including T2 GUI, CRDM, reconciliation systems, liquidity-monitoring platforms, and U2A/A2A actions.
    • Proven ability to design, document, and implement operational processes, including detailed SOPs, four-eyes controls, authorization matrices, escalation procedures, and audit-ready evidence.
    • Experience coordinating with regulators, central banks, scheme operators, SWIFT/NSP providers, service providers, correspondent banks, and other external stakeholders.
